built with pdoc

qurankit

QuranKit - A modular, Python-first computational Qur'anic research library.

Provides tools for accessing and navigating Qur'anic text, searching surahs, ayahs, and words, exploring Arabic words, roots, lemmas, and morphology, analyzing repeated expressions and relationships between ayahs, and performing reproducible computational and statistical research.

  1"""
  2QuranKit - A modular, Python-first computational Qur'anic research library.
  3
  4Provides tools for accessing and navigating Qur'anic text, searching surahs,
  5ayahs, and words, exploring Arabic words, roots, lemmas, and morphology,
  6analyzing repeated expressions and relationships between ayahs, and
  7performing reproducible computational and statistical research.
  8"""

class Quran(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
 42class Quran(BaseModel):
 43    """
 44    Main interface for accessing Qur'anic text.
 45
 46    This class provides methods to load datasets, retrieve surahs and ayahs,
 47    and perform searches. It maintains the current dataset and edition context.
 48    """
 49
 50    model_config = ConfigDict(
 51        arbitrary_types_allowed=True,
 52        extra="forbid",
 53    )
 54
 55    config: QuranKitConfig = Field(default_factory=get_config)
 56    edition_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="Current text edition")
 57
 58    # Private attributes (not Pydantic fields)
 59    _data_access: DataAccess = PrivateAttr(default_factory=DataAccess)
 60    _search_engine: SearchEngine = PrivateAttr(default=None)
 61    _vocabulary: Any = PrivateAttr(default=None)
 62    _loaded: bool = PrivateAttr(default=False)
 63
 64    def __init__(self, **data: Any) -> None:
 65        super().__init__(**data)
 66        self._data_access = DataAccess(get_database(self.config.data_dir))
 67        # Lazy import to avoid circular dependency
 68        from qurankit.search.engine import SearchEngine
 69        self._search_engine = SearchEngine(self._data_access)
 70
 71    @classmethod
 72    def load(
 73        cls,
 74        edition_id: str | None = None,
 75        config: QuranKitConfig | None = None,
 76    ) -> Quran:
 77        """
 78        Load a Quran instance with the specified edition.
 79
 80        Args:
 81            edition_id: Text edition to use (defaults to config default)
 82            config: Configuration instance (uses global if not provided)
 83
 84        Returns:
 85            Quran instance ready for queries
 86
 87        Raises:
 88            DatasetNotFoundError: If the required dataset is not installed
 89            UnsupportedEditionError: If the edition is not available
 90        """
 91        cfg = config or get_config()
 92        edition = edition_id or cfg.default_edition
 93
 94        quran = cls(config=cfg, edition_id=edition)
 95        quran._load_dataset()
 96        return quran
 97
 98    def _load_dataset(self) -> None:
 99        """Load the dataset for the current edition."""
100        if not self._loaded:
101            self._initialize_database()
102            self._loaded = True
103
104    def _initialize_database(self) -> None:
105        """Initialize database and load built-in reference data."""
106        db = get_database()
107        db.initialize_schema()
108
109        # Initialize normalization profiles in database
110        self._ensure_normalization_profiles()
111
112        # Initialize surah reference data if not present
113        self._ensure_surah_data()
114
115        # Initialize dataset and edition if not present
116        self._ensure_dataset_and_edition()
117
118    def _ensure_normalization_profiles(self) -> None:
119        """Ensure normalization profiles are in database."""
120        profiles = [
121            NormalizationProfile(
122                profile_id="exact-source-v1",
123                name="Exact Source",
124                version="1.0.0",
125                description="Exact comparison with the selected source representation",
126                rules_json={"type": "exact"},
127                implementation_version="0.1.0",
128            ),
129            NormalizationProfile(
130                profile_id="diacritics-insensitive-v1",
131                name="Diacritic Insensitive",
132                version="1.0.0",
133                description="Match regardless of specified vocalization marks",
134                rules_json={
135                    "type": "diacritics_insensitive",
136                    "remove": ["fatha", "damma", "kasra", "tanwin", "shadda", "sukun"],
137                },
138                implementation_version="0.1.0",
139            ),
140            NormalizationProfile(
141                profile_id="search-broad-v1",
142                name="Broad Search",
143                version="1.0.0",
144                description="Broad discovery with configurable equivalences",
145                rules_json={
146                    "type": "broad",
147                    "alif_hamza_equivalence": True,
148                    "ya_maqsurah_equivalence": True,
149                    "remove_diacritics": True,
150                },
151                implementation_version="0.1.0",
152            ),
153            NormalizationProfile(
154                profile_id="canonical-unicode-v1",
155                name="Canonical Unicode",
156                version="1.0.0",
157                description="Unicode NFC normalization only",
158                rules_json={"type": "canonical_unicode"},
159                implementation_version="0.1.0",
160            ),
161        ]
162
163        for profile in profiles:
164            existing = self._data_access.get_normalization_profile(profile.profile_id)
165            if existing is None:
166                self._data_access.insert_normalization_profile(profile)

303    def _ensure_dataset_and_edition(self) -> None:
304        """Ensure dataset and edition are in database."""
305        dataset_id = "tanzil-quran-text"
306        edition_id = self.edition_id
307
308        # Check if dataset exists
309        db = get_database()
310        dataset_row = db.fetchone("SELECT * FROM dataset WHERE dataset_id = ?", (dataset_id,))
311
312        if dataset_row is None:
313            # Create source
314            source = Source(
315                source_id="tanzil-project",
316                title="Tanzil Quran Text",
317                creator="Tanzil Project",
318                source_type=SourceType.CORPUS,
319                url="https://tanzil.net/",
320                publisher="Tanzil Project",
321                publication_year=2021,
322            )
323            self._data_access.insert_source(source)
324
325            # Create dataset
326            dataset = Dataset(
327                dataset_id=dataset_id,
328                version="1.1",
329                source_id="tanzil-project",
330                name="Tanzil Quran Text - Uthmani",
331                description="Verified Uthmani Quranic text from Tanzil Project",
332                license_id="CC-BY-3.0",
333                license_url="https://tanzil.net/docs/Text_License",
334                redistribution_status=RedistributionStatus.ALLOWED,
335                retrieved_at=datetime.now(UTC),
336                checksum_algorithm="sha256",
337                schema_version="1.0",
338                language="ar",
339            )
340            self._data_access.insert_dataset(dataset)
341
342        # Check if edition exists
343        edition = self._data_access.get_text_edition(edition_id)
344        if edition is not None:
345            return
346
347        # Create default edition
348        default_edition = TextEdition(
349            edition_id=edition_id,
350            dataset_id=dataset_id,
351            name="Tanzil Uthmani Text",
352            script_type=ScriptType.UTHMANI,
353            is_default=True,
354            notes="Imported from Tanzil Project quran.xml",
355        )
356        self._data_access.insert_text_edition(default_edition)
357
358    # --- Surah access ---
359
360    def surah(self, surah_number: int) -> Surah:
361        """
362        Get a surah by number.
363
364        Args:
365            surah_number: Surah number (1-114)
366
367        Returns:
368            Surah object
369
370        Raises:
371            InvalidReferenceError: If surah number is invalid
372        """
373        if not 1 <= surah_number <= 114:
374            raise InvalidReferenceError(f"surah:{surah_number}")
375
376        surah = self._data_access.get_surah(surah_number)
377        if surah is None:
378            raise InvalidReferenceError(f"surah:{surah_number} not loaded")
379
380        return surah
381
382    def surahs(self) -> list[Surah]:
383        """Get all surahs in order."""
384        return self._data_access.get_all_surahs()
385
386    # --- Ayah access ---
387
388    def ayah(self, surah_number: int, ayah_number: int) -> Ayah:
389        """
390        Get an ayah by reference.
391
392        Args:
393            surah_number: Surah number (1-114)
394            ayah_number: Ayah number within surah
395
396        Returns:
397            Ayah object
398
399        Raises:
400            InvalidReferenceError: If reference is invalid
401        """
402        surah = self.surah(surah_number)
403        if not 1 <= ayah_number <= surah.ayah_count:
404            raise InvalidReferenceError(f"{surah_number}:{ayah_number}")
405
406        return Ayah(surah_number=surah_number, ayah_number=ayah_number)
407
408    def ayah_text(
409        self,
410        surah_number: int,
411        ayah_number: int,
412        edition_id: str | None = None,
413    ) -> AyahText:
414        """
415        Get the text of an ayah in a specific edition.
416
417        Args:
418            surah_number: Surah number
419            ayah_number: Ayah number
420            edition_id: Text edition (uses current if not specified)
421
422        Returns:
423            AyahText with original source text
424
425        Raises:
426            InvalidReferenceError: If reference is invalid
427            UnsupportedEditionError: If edition is not available
428        """
429        edition = edition_id or self.edition_id
430        if not edition:
431            raise UnsupportedEditionError("No edition specified")
432
433        edition_obj = self._data_access.get_text_edition(edition)
434        if edition_obj is None:
435            raise UnsupportedEditionError(edition)
436
437        self.ayah(surah_number, ayah_number)  # Validate reference
438
439        ayah_text = self._data_access.get_ayah_text(edition, surah_number, ayah_number)
440        if ayah_text is not None:
441            return ayah_text
442
443        # Return placeholder if not in database
444        return AyahText(
445            edition_id=edition,
446            surah_number=surah_number,
447            ayah_number=ayah_number,
448            text_original=f"[Text for {surah_number}:{ayah_number} in {edition} - not loaded]",
449            checksum="placeholder",
450        )
451
452    def ayah_texts_for_surah(
453        self,
454        surah_number: int,
455        edition_id: str | None = None,
456    ) -> list[AyahText]:
457        """Get all ayah texts for a surah."""
458        edition = edition_id or self.edition_id
459        if not edition:
460            raise UnsupportedEditionError("No edition specified")
461
462        return self._data_access.get_ayah_texts_for_surah(edition, surah_number)
463
464    # --- Word token access ---
465
466    def word_tokens(
467        self,
468        surah_number: int,
469        ayah_number: int,
470        edition_id: str | None = None,
471        tokenization_id: str | None = None,
472    ) -> list[WordToken]:
473        """
474        Get word tokens for an ayah.
475
476        Args:
477            surah_number: Surah number
478            ayah_number: Ayah number
479            edition_id: Text edition
480            tokenization_id: Tokenization scheme
481
482        Returns:
483            List of WordToken objects
484        """
485        edition = edition_id or self.edition_id
486        if not edition:
487            raise UnsupportedEditionError("No edition specified")
488
489        tok_id = tokenization_id or "tanzil-words-v1"
490        tokens = self._data_access.get_word_tokens(edition, surah_number, ayah_number, tok_id)
491
492        # If no tokens in database, return mock tokens for testing
493        if not tokens:
494            tokens = []
495            for i in range(1, 5):  # Mock 4 tokens
496                token = WordToken(
497                    token_id=f"{edition}:{surah_number}:{ayah_number}:{tok_id}:{i}",
498                    edition_id=edition,
499                    surah_number=surah_number,
500                    ayah_number=ayah_number,
501                    tokenization_id=tok_id,
502                    token_index=i,
503                    surface_original=f"[token{i}]",
504                )
505                tokens.append(token)
506        return tokens
507
508    # --- Vocabulary / Lexicon integration ---
509
510    @property
511    def vocabulary(self):
512        """
513        Get the QuranicVocabulary analyzer for the current edition.
514
515        Provides access to root/lemma occurrence lookup, concordance,
516        frequency lists, and vocabulary statistics.

521        if self._vocabulary is None:

523            self._vocabulary = QuranicVocabulary(
524                data_access=self._data_access,
525                edition_id=self.edition_id or "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
526            )
527        return self._vocabulary

755    def search(
756        self,
757        query: str,
758        mode: str = "diacritics_insensitive",
759        edition_id: str | None = None,
760        normalization_profile: str | None = None,
761        limit: int = 100,
762    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
763        """
764        Search for text in the Qur'an.
765
766        Args:
767            query: Search query string
768            mode: Search mode (exact_source, canonical_unicode, diacritics_insensitive, broad_orthographic)
769            edition_id: Text edition to search
770            normalization_profile: Normalization profile to use
771            limit: Maximum number of results
772
773        Returns:
774            List of search results with references and matched text
775        """
776        # Convert string mode to SearchMode enum
777        from qurankit.models.enums import SearchMode
778
779        mode_map = {
780            "exact_source": SearchMode.EXACT_SOURCE,
781            "canonical_unicode": SearchMode.CANONICAL_UNICODE,
782            "diacritics_insensitive": SearchMode.DIACRITICS_INSENSITIVE,
783            "broad_orthographic": SearchMode.BROAD_ORTHOGRAPHIC,
784            "token_sequence": SearchMode.TOKEN_SEQUENCE,
785            "lemma": SearchMode.LEMMA,
786            "root": SearchMode.ROOT,
787            "fuzzy": SearchMode.FUZZY,
788            "semantic": SearchMode.SEMANTIC,
789        }
790
791        search_mode = mode_map.get(mode, SearchMode.DIACRITICS_INSENSITIVE)
792
793        results = self._search_engine.search(
794            query=query,
795            mode=search_mode,
796            edition_id=edition_id,
797            normalization_profile=normalization_profile,
798            limit=limit,
799        )
800
801        # Convert to dict for backward compatibility
802        return [
803            {
804                "reference": r.reference,
805                "surah_number": r.surah_number,
806                "ayah_number": r.ayah_number,
807                "edition_id": r.edition_id,
808                "matched_text": r.matched_text,
809                "match_type": r.match_type.value,
810                "normalization_profile": r.normalization_profile,
811                "query": r.query,
812                "normalized_query": r.normalized_query,
813                "score": r.score,
814            }
815            for r in results
816        ]
817

Main interface for accessing Qur'anic text.

This class provides methods to load datasets, retrieve surahs and ayahs, and perform searches. It maintains the current dataset and edition context.

config: QuranKitConfig = PydanticUndefined

@classmethod
def load( cls, edition_id: str | None = None, config: QuranKitConfig | None = None) -> Quran: 
71    @classmethod
72    def load(
73        cls,
74        edition_id: str | None = None,
75        config: QuranKitConfig | None = None,
76    ) -> Quran:
77        """
78        Load a Quran instance with the specified edition.
79
80        Args:
81            edition_id: Text edition to use (defaults to config default)
82            config: Configuration instance (uses global if not provided)
83
84        Returns:
85            Quran instance ready for queries
86
87        Raises:
88            DatasetNotFoundError: If the required dataset is not installed
89            UnsupportedEditionError: If the edition is not available
90        """
91        cfg = config or get_config()
92        edition = edition_id or cfg.default_edition
93
94        quran = cls(config=cfg, edition_id=edition)
95        quran._load_dataset()
96        return quran

def ayah_text( self, surah_number: int, ayah_number: int, edition_id: str | None = None) -> AyahText: 
408    def ayah_text(
409        self,
410        surah_number: int,
411        ayah_number: int,
412        edition_id: str | None = None,
413    ) -> AyahText:
414        """
415        Get the text of an ayah in a specific edition.
416
417        Args:
418            surah_number: Surah number
419            ayah_number: Ayah number
420            edition_id: Text edition (uses current if not specified)
421
422        Returns:
423            AyahText with original source text
424
425        Raises:
426            InvalidReferenceError: If reference is invalid
427            UnsupportedEditionError: If edition is not available
428        """
429        edition = edition_id or self.edition_id
430        if not edition:
431            raise UnsupportedEditionError("No edition specified")
432
433        edition_obj = self._data_access.get_text_edition(edition)
434        if edition_obj is None:
435            raise UnsupportedEditionError(edition)
436
437        self.ayah(surah_number, ayah_number)  # Validate reference
438
439        ayah_text = self._data_access.get_ayah_text(edition, surah_number, ayah_number)
440        if ayah_text is not None:
441            return ayah_text
442
443        # Return placeholder if not in database
444        return AyahText(
445            edition_id=edition,
446            surah_number=surah_number,
447            ayah_number=ayah_number,
448            text_original=f"[Text for {surah_number}:{ayah_number} in {edition} - not loaded]",
449            checksum="placeholder",
450        )

473        """

498                    edition_id=edition,
499                    surah_number=surah_number,
500                    ayah_number=ayah_number,
501                    tokenization_id=tok_id,
502                    token_index=i,
503                    surface_original=f"[token{i}]",
504                )
505                tokens.append(token)
506        return tokens

623        surface_form: str | None = None,

631            surface_form: Exact surface form
632
633        Returns:

635        """

638            lemma_form=lemma_form,
639            surface_form=surface_form,
640        )

642            "root_form": stats.root_form,
643            "lemma_form": stats.lemma_form,
644            "surface_form": stats.surface_form,
645            "total_occurrences": stats.total_occurrences,
646            "unique_surahs": stats.unique_surahs,
647            "unique_ayahs": stats.unique_ayahs,
648            "first_occurrence": (
649                {"surah": stats.first_occurrence.surah_number, "ayah": stats.first_occurrence.ayah_number}
650                if stats.first_occurrence else None
651            ),
652            "last_occurrence": (
653                {"surah": stats.last_occurrence.surah_number, "ayah": stats.last_occurrence.ayah_number}
654                if stats.last_occurrence else None
655            ),
656            "surah_distribution": stats.surah_distribution,
657            "juz_distribution": stats.juz_distribution,
658        }

def search( self, query: str, mode: str = 'diacritics_insensitive', edition_id: str | None = None, normalization_profile: str | None = None, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict[str, typing.Any]]: 
755    def search(
756        self,
757        query: str,
758        mode: str = "diacritics_insensitive",
759        edition_id: str | None = None,
760        normalization_profile: str | None = None,
761        limit: int = 100,
762    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
763        """
764        Search for text in the Qur'an.
765
766        Args:
767            query: Search query string
768            mode: Search mode (exact_source, canonical_unicode, diacritics_insensitive, broad_orthographic)
769            edition_id: Text edition to search
770            normalization_profile: Normalization profile to use
771            limit: Maximum number of results
772
773        Returns:
774            List of search results with references and matched text
775        """
776        # Convert string mode to SearchMode enum
777        from qurankit.models.enums import SearchMode
778
779        mode_map = {
780            "exact_source": SearchMode.EXACT_SOURCE,
781            "canonical_unicode": SearchMode.CANONICAL_UNICODE,
782            "diacritics_insensitive": SearchMode.DIACRITICS_INSENSITIVE,
783            "broad_orthographic": SearchMode.BROAD_ORTHOGRAPHIC,
784            "token_sequence": SearchMode.TOKEN_SEQUENCE,
785            "lemma": SearchMode.LEMMA,
786            "root": SearchMode.ROOT,
787            "fuzzy": SearchMode.FUZZY,
788            "semantic": SearchMode.SEMANTIC,
789        }
790
791        search_mode = mode_map.get(mode, SearchMode.DIACRITICS_INSENSITIVE)
792
793        results = self._search_engine.search(
794            query=query,
795            mode=search_mode,
796            edition_id=edition_id,
797            normalization_profile=normalization_profile,
798            limit=limit,
799        )
800
801        # Convert to dict for backward compatibility
802        return [
803            {
804                "reference": r.reference,
805                "surah_number": r.surah_number,
806                "ayah_number": r.ayah_number,
807                "edition_id": r.edition_id,
808                "matched_text": r.matched_text,
809                "match_type": r.match_type.value,
810                "normalization_profile": r.normalization_profile,
811                "query": r.query,
812                "normalized_query": r.normalized_query,
813                "score": r.score,
814            }
815            for r in results
816        ]

class DatasetRegistry(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
 14class DatasetRegistry(BaseModel):
 15    """Registry for managing installed datasets."""
 16
 17    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True, extra="forbid")
 18
 19    data_dir: Path = Field(default_factory=lambda: get_config().get_data_dir())
 20    _manifests: dict[str, DatasetManifest] = PrivateAttr(default_factory=dict)
 21    _loaded: bool = PrivateAttr(default=False)
 22
 23    def load(self) -> None:
 24        """Load all manifests from the data directory."""
 25        if self._loaded:
 26            return
 27
 28        manifests_dir = self.data_dir / "manifests"
 29        if not manifests_dir.exists():
 30            self._loaded = True
 31            return
 32
 33        for manifest_file in manifests_dir.glob("*.json"):
 34            try:
 35                with open(manifest_file, encoding="utf-8") as f:
 36                    data = json.load(f)
 37                manifest = DatasetManifest.model_validate(data)
 38                self._manifests[manifest.dataset.dataset_id] = manifest
 39            except Exception as e:
 40                # Log error but continue loading other manifests
 41                print(f"Warning: Failed to load manifest {manifest_file}: {e}")
 42
 43        self._loaded = True
 44
 45    def register(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> None:
 46        """Register a dataset manifest."""
 47        self._manifests[manifest.dataset.dataset_id] = manifest
 48        self._save_manifest(manifest)
 49
 50    def _save_manifest(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> None:
 51        """Save a manifest to disk."""
 52        manifests_dir = self.data_dir / "manifests"
 53        manifests_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 54
 55        manifest_file = manifests_dir / f"{manifest.dataset.dataset_id}.json"
 56        with open(manifest_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 57            json.dump(manifest.model_dump(mode="json"), f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
 58
 59    def get(self, dataset_id: str) -> DatasetManifest:
 60        """Get a dataset manifest by ID."""
 61        self.load()
 62        if dataset_id not in self._manifests:
 63            raise DatasetNotFoundError(dataset_id)
 64        return self._manifests[dataset_id]
 65
 66    def get_dataset(self, dataset_id: str) -> Dataset:
 67        """Get a dataset by ID."""
 68        return self.get(dataset_id).dataset
 69
 70    def get_source(self, dataset_id: str) -> Source:
 71        """Get the source for a dataset."""
 72        return self.get(dataset_id).source
 73
 74    def list_datasets(self) -> list[Dataset]:
 75        """List all registered datasets."""
 76        self.load()
 77        return [m.dataset for m in self._manifests.values()]
 78
 79    def list_manifests(self) -> list[DatasetManifest]:
 80        """List all registered manifests."""
 81        self.load()
 82        return list(self._manifests.values())
 83
 84    def is_installed(self, dataset_id: str) -> bool:
 85        """Check if a dataset is installed."""
 86        self.load()
 87        return dataset_id in self._manifests
 88
 89    def unregister(self, dataset_id: str) -> None:
 90        """Unregister a dataset (removes manifest only, not data files)."""
 91        self.load()
 92        if dataset_id not in self._manifests:
 93            raise DatasetNotFoundError(dataset_id)
 94
 95        del self._manifests[dataset_id]
 96
 97        manifest_file = self.data_dir / "manifests" / f"{dataset_id}.json"
 98        if manifest_file.exists():
 99            manifest_file.unlink()
100
101    def verify_checksums(self, dataset_id: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
102        """Verify checksums for all files in a dataset."""
103        manifest = self.get(dataset_id)
104        results = {}
105
106        for file_info in manifest.files:
107            file_path = self.data_dir / "sources" / file_info.get("path", "")
108            expected = file_info.get("checksum")
109            algorithm = file_info.get("algorithm", "sha256")
110
111            if not file_path.exists():
112                results[file_info.get("path", "unknown")] = False
113                continue
114
115            if algorithm == "sha256":
116                import hashlib
117
118                hasher = hashlib.sha256()
119                with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
120                    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
121                        hasher.update(chunk)
122                actual = hasher.hexdigest()
123                results[file_info.get("path", "unknown")] = actual == expected
124            else:
125                results[file_info.get("path", "unknown")] = False
126
127        return results

def verify_checksums(self, dataset_id: str) -> dict[str, bool]: 
101    def verify_checksums(self, dataset_id: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
102        """Verify checksums for all files in a dataset."""
103        manifest = self.get(dataset_id)
104        results = {}
105
106        for file_info in manifest.files:
107            file_path = self.data_dir / "sources" / file_info.get("path", "")
108            expected = file_info.get("checksum")
109            algorithm = file_info.get("algorithm", "sha256")
110
111            if not file_path.exists():
112                results[file_info.get("path", "unknown")] = False
113                continue
114
115            if algorithm == "sha256":
116                import hashlib
117
118                hasher = hashlib.sha256()
119                with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
120                    for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
121                        hasher.update(chunk)
122                actual = hasher.hexdigest()
123                results[file_info.get("path", "unknown")] = actual == expected
124            else:
125                results[file_info.get("path", "unknown")] = False
126
127        return results

Verify checksums for all files in a dataset.

class ManifestManager(pydantic.main.BaseModel): 
 17class ManifestManager(BaseModel):
 18    """Manager for creating and validating dataset manifests."""
 19
 20    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True, extra="forbid")
 21
 22    def create_manifest(
 23        self,
 24        dataset: Dataset,
 25        source: Source,
 26        source_files: list[Path],
 27        validation_report: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
 28    ) -> DatasetManifest:
 29        """
 30        Create a complete dataset manifest with file checksums.
 31
 32        Args:
 33            dataset: Dataset metadata
 34            source: Source information
 35            source_files: List of source file paths
 36            validation_report: Optional validation results
 37
 38        Returns:
 39            Complete DatasetManifest
 40        """
 41        files = []
 42        for file_path in source_files:
 43            if not file_path.exists():
 44                raise ProvenanceError(dataset.dataset_id, f"Source file not found: {file_path}")
 45
 46            # Compute SHA-256
 47            hasher = hashlib.sha256()
 48            with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
 49                for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
 50                    hasher.update(chunk)
 51
 52            files.append({
 53                "path": str(file_path.name),
 54                "size": file_path.stat().st_size,
 55                "algorithm": "sha256",
 56                "checksum": hasher.hexdigest(),
 57            })
 58
 59        manifest = DatasetManifest(
 60            dataset=dataset,
 61            source=source,
 62            files=files,
 63            validation_report=validation_report,
 64            created_at=datetime.now(UTC),
 65        )
 66
 67        return manifest
 68
 69    def save_manifest(self, manifest: DatasetManifest, output_path: Path) -> None:
 70        """Save a manifest to a JSON file."""
 71        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 72        with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 73            json.dump(manifest.model_dump(mode="json"), f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
 74
 75    def load_manifest(self, manifest_path: Path) -> DatasetManifest:
 76        """Load a manifest from a JSON file."""
 77        with open(manifest_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
 78            data = json.load(f)
 79        return DatasetManifest.model_validate(data)
 80
 81    @staticmethod
 82    def create_tanzil_manifest(
 83        version: str = "1.1",
 84        retrieved_at: datetime | None = None,
 85        text_file: Path | None = None,
 86        metadata_file: Path | None = None,
 87    ) -> DatasetManifest:
 88        """Create a manifest for the Tanzil Quran text dataset."""
 89
 90        source = Source(
 91            source_id="tanzil-project",
 92            title="Tanzil Quran Text",
 93            creator="Tanzil Project",
 94            source_type=SourceType.CORPUS,
 95            url="https://tanzil.net/",
 96            persistent_id=None,
 97            publisher="Tanzil Project",
 98            publication_year=2021,
 99            notes="Quran text verified and monitored by Tanzil Project",
100        )
101
102        dataset = Dataset(

108            license_id="CC-BY-3.0",
109            license_url="https://tanzil.net/docs/Text_License",
110            redistribution_status=RedistributionStatus.ALLOWED,
111            retrieved_at=retrieved_at or datetime.now(UTC),

126        return manager.create_manifest(dataset, source, source_files)

152    def __init__(self) -> None:
153        self.issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
154
155    def validate_manifest(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
156        """Validate a dataset manifest."""
157        self.issues = []
158
159        # Check required fields
160        self._check_required_fields(manifest)
161
162        # Check license and redistribution
163        self._check_licensing(manifest)
164
165        # Check file checksums
166        self._check_file_checksums(manifest)
167
168        return self.issues
169
170    def _check_required_fields(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> None:
171        """Check that all required manifest fields are present."""
172        dataset = manifest.dataset
173        source = manifest.source
174
175        if not dataset.dataset_id:
176            self.issues.append(
177                ValidationIssue(
178                    ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
179                    "MISSING_DATASET_ID",
180                    "Dataset ID is required",
181                )
182            )
183
184        if not dataset.version:
185            self.issues.append(
186                ValidationIssue(
187                    ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
188                    "MISSING_VERSION",
189                    "Dataset version is required",
190                )
191            )
192
193        if not dataset.source_id:
194            self.issues.append(
195                ValidationIssue(
196                    ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
197                    "MISSING_SOURCE_ID",
198                    "Dataset source_id is required",
199                )
200            )
201
202        if not source.source_id:
203            self.issues.append(
204                ValidationIssue(
205                    ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
206                    "MISSING_SOURCE_ID",
207                    "Source ID is required",
208                )
209            )
210
211        if not source.title:
212            self.issues.append(
213                ValidationIssue(
214                    ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
215                    "MISSING_SOURCE_TITLE",
216                    "Source title is required",
217                )
218            )
219
220        if dataset.redistribution_status.value == "unknown":
221            self.issues.append(
222                ValidationIssue(
223                    ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
224                    "UNKNOWN_REDISTRIBUTION",
225                    "Redistribution status is unknown - verify before publishing",
226                )
227            )
228
229    def _check_licensing(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> None:
230        """Check licensing information."""
231        dataset = manifest.dataset
232
233        if not dataset.license_id:
234            self.issues.append(
235                ValidationIssue(
236                    ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
237                    "MISSING_LICENSE",
238                    "No license ID specified",
239                )
240            )
241
242        if not dataset.license_url:
243            self.issues.append(
244                ValidationIssue(
245                    ValidationSeverity.INFO,
246                    "MISSING_LICENSE_URL",
247                    "No license URL specified",
248                )
249            )
250
251    def _check_file_checksums(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> None:
252        """Validate file checksums are present."""
253        for i, file_info in enumerate(manifest.files):
254            if not file_info.get("checksum"):
255                self.issues.append(
256                    ValidationIssue(
257                        ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
258                        "MISSING_CHECKSUM",
259                        f"File {i} missing checksum",
260                        location=file_info.get("path"),
261                    )
262                )
263            if not file_info.get("algorithm"):
264                self.issues.append(
265                    ValidationIssue(
266                        ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
267                        "MISSING_ALGORITHM",
268                        f"File {i} missing checksum algorithm",
269                        location=file_info.get("path"),
270                    )
271                )
272
273    def validate_surah_structure(self, surahs: list[Surah]) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
274        """Validate surah structure against expected counts."""
275        self.issues = []
276
277        # Check surah count
278        if len(surahs) != 114:
279            self.issues.append(
280                ValidationIssue(
281                    ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
282                    "INVALID_SURAH_COUNT",
283                    f"Expected 114 surahs, got {len(surahs)}",
284                )
285            )
286
287        # Check each surah
288        surah_numbers = set()
289        for surah in surahs:
290            if surah.surah_number in surah_numbers:
291                self.issues.append(
292                    ValidationIssue(
293                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
294                        "DUPLICATE_SURAH",
295                        f"Duplicate surah number: {surah.surah_number}",
296                    )
297                )
298            surah_numbers.add(surah.surah_number)
299
300            # Check ayah count
301            expected = self.EXPECTED_AYAH_COUNTS.get(surah.surah_number)
302            if expected is not None and surah.ayah_count != expected:
303                self.issues.append(
304                    ValidationIssue(
305                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
306                        "INVALID_AYAH_COUNT",
307                        f"Surah {surah.surah_number}: expected {expected} ayahs, got {surah.ayah_count}",
308                    )
309                )
310
311        # Check for missing surahs
312        for i in range(1, 115):
313            if i not in surah_numbers:
314                self.issues.append(
315                    ValidationIssue(
316                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
317                        "MISSING_SURAH",
318                        f"Missing surah: {i}",
319                    )
320                )
321
322        return self.issues
323
324    def validate_ayah_texts(
325        self,
326        ayah_texts: list[Any],  # AyahText objects
327        edition_id: str,
328    ) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
329        """Validate ayah text records."""
330        self.issues = []
331
332        seen = set()
333        for ayah_text in ayah_texts:
334            key = (ayah_text.edition_id, ayah_text.surah_number, ayah_text.ayah_number)
335
336            if key in seen:
337                self.issues.append(
338                    ValidationIssue(
339                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
340                        "DUPLICATE_AYAH_TEXT",
341                        f"Duplicate ayah text: {ayah_text.edition_id}:{ayah_text.surah_number}:{ayah_text.ayah_number}",
342                    )
343                )
344            seen.add(key)
345
346            # Check text is not empty
347            if not ayah_text.text_original or not ayah_text.text_original.strip():
348                self.issues.append(
349                    ValidationIssue(
350                        ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
351                        "EMPTY_AYAH_TEXT",
352                        f"Empty text for {ayah_text.edition_id}:{ayah_text.surah_number}:{ayah_text.ayah_number}",
353                    )
354                )
355
356            # Verify checksum if present
357            if ayah_text.checksum:
358                import hashlib
359
360                computed = hashlib.sha256(ayah_text.text_original.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
361                if computed != ayah_text.checksum:
362                    self.issues.append(
363                        ValidationIssue(
364                            ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
365                            "CHECKSUM_MISMATCH",
366                            f"Checksum mismatch for {ayah_text.edition_id}:{ayah_text.surah_number}:{ayah_text.ayah_number}",
367                        )
368                    )
369
370        # Check for missing ayahs (basic check)
371        expected_total = sum(self.EXPECTED_AYAH_COUNTS.values())
372        if len(seen) < expected_total:
373            self.issues.append(
374                ValidationIssue(
375                    ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
376                    "INCOMPLETE_AYAH_COVERAGE",
377                    f"Edition {edition_id}: {len(seen)}/{expected_total} ayahs present",
378                )
379            )
380
381        return self.issues
382
383    def has_errors(self) -> bool:
384        """Check if any errors were found."""
385        return any(i.severity == ValidationSeverity.ERROR for i in self.issues)
386
387    def get_errors(self) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
388        """Get all error-level issues."""
389        return [i for i in self.issues if i.severity == ValidationSeverity.ERROR]
390
391    def get_warnings(self) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
392        """Get all warning-level issues."""
393        return [i for i in self.issues if i.severity == ValidationSeverity.WARNING]
394
395    def raise_if_errors(self) -> None:
396        """Raise ValidationError if any errors were found."""
397        errors = self.get_errors()
398        if errors:
399            raise ValidationError([str(e) for e in errors])

Validates dataset integrity and consistency.

283                    f"Expected 114 surahs, got {len(surahs)}",
284                )
285            )
286
287        # Check each surah
288        surah_numbers = set()
289        for surah in surahs:
290            if surah.surah_number in surah_numbers:
291                self.issues.append(
292                    ValidationIssue(
293                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
294                        "DUPLICATE_SURAH",
295                        f"Duplicate surah number: {surah.surah_number}",
296                    )
297                )
298            surah_numbers.add(surah.surah_number)
299
300            # Check ayah count
301            expected = self.EXPECTED_AYAH_COUNTS.get(surah.surah_number)
302            if expected is not None and surah.ayah_count != expected:
303                self.issues.append(
304                    ValidationIssue(
305                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
306                        "INVALID_AYAH_COUNT",
307                        f"Surah {surah.surah_number}: expected {expected} ayahs, got {surah.ayah_count}",
308                    )
309                )
310
311        # Check for missing surahs
312        for i in range(1, 115):
313            if i not in surah_numbers:
314                self.issues.append(
315                    ValidationIssue(
316                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
317                        "MISSING_SURAH",
318                        f"Missing surah: {i}",
319                    )
320                )
321
322        return self.issues

Validate surah structure against expected counts.

def validate_ayah_texts( self, ayah_texts: list[typing.Any], edition_id: str) -> list[qurankit.datasets.validation.ValidationIssue]: 
324    def validate_ayah_texts(
325        self,
326        ayah_texts: list[Any],  # AyahText objects
327        edition_id: str,
328    ) -> list[ValidationIssue]:
329        """Validate ayah text records."""
330        self.issues = []
331
332        seen = set()
333        for ayah_text in ayah_texts:
334            key = (ayah_text.edition_id, ayah_text.surah_number, ayah_text.ayah_number)
335
336            if key in seen:
337                self.issues.append(
338                    ValidationIssue(
339                        ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
340                        "DUPLICATE_AYAH_TEXT",
341                        f"Duplicate ayah text: {ayah_text.edition_id}:{ayah_text.surah_number}:{ayah_text.ayah_number}",
342                    )
343                )
344            seen.add(key)
345
346            # Check text is not empty
347            if not ayah_text.text_original or not ayah_text.text_original.strip():
348                self.issues.append(
349                    ValidationIssue(
350                        ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
351                        "EMPTY_AYAH_TEXT",
352                        f"Empty text for {ayah_text.edition_id}:{ayah_text.surah_number}:{ayah_text.ayah_number}",
353                    )
354                )
355
356            # Verify checksum if present
357            if ayah_text.checksum:
358                import hashlib
359
360                computed = hashlib.sha256(ayah_text.text_original.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
361                if computed != ayah_text.checksum:
362                    self.issues.append(
363                        ValidationIssue(
364                            ValidationSeverity.ERROR,
365                            "CHECKSUM_MISMATCH",
366                            f"Checksum mismatch for {ayah_text.edition_id}:{ayah_text.surah_number}:{ayah_text.ayah_number}",
367                        )
368                    )
369
370        # Check for missing ayahs (basic check)
371        expected_total = sum(self.EXPECTED_AYAH_COUNTS.values())
372        if len(seen) < expected_total:
373            self.issues.append(
374                ValidationIssue(
375                    ValidationSeverity.WARNING,
376                    "INCOMPLETE_AYAH_COVERAGE",
377                    f"Edition {edition_id}: {len(seen)}/{expected_total} ayahs present",
378                )
379            )
380
381        return self.issues

Validate ayah text records.

def has_errors(self) -> bool: 
383    def has_errors(self) -> bool:
384        """Check if any errors were found."""
385        return any(i.severity == ValidationSeverity.ERROR for i in self.issues)

Check if any errors were found.

Get all error-level issues.

Get all warning-level issues.

 25class ImportPipeline:
 26    """
 27    Pipeline for importing dataset data into QuranKit storage.
 28
 29    Takes parsed data from providers and persists it to the database
 30    with proper provenance tracking.
 31    """
 32
 33    def __init__(self, data_access: DataAccess | None = None):
 34        """
 35        Initialize import pipeline.
 36
 37        Args:
 38            data_access: DataAccess instance. If None, creates one.
 39        """
 40        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
 41
 42    def import_surahs(self, surahs: list[Surah], source_id: str) -> None:
 43        """Import surah reference data."""
 44        for surah in surahs:
 45            # Create new surah with source_id (since Surah is frozen)
 46            surah_with_source = Surah(
 47                surah_number=surah.surah_number,
 48                name_arabic=surah.name_arabic,
 49                name_transliteration=surah.name_transliteration,
 50                name_translation=surah.name_translation,
 51                ayah_count=surah.ayah_count,
 52                metadata_source_id=source_id,
 53            )
 54            self.data_access.insert_surah(surah_with_source)
 55
 56    def import_text_edition(self, edition: TextEdition) -> None:
 57        """Import a text edition."""
 58        self.data_access.insert_text_edition(edition)
 59
 60    def import_ayah_texts(self, ayah_texts: list[AyahText]) -> None:
 61        """Import ayah text records."""
 62        for ayah_text in ayah_texts:
 63            self.data_access.insert_ayah_text(ayah_text)
 64
 65    def import_word_tokens(self, tokens: list[WordToken]) -> None:
 66        """Import word token records."""
 67        for token in tokens:
 68            self.data_access.insert_word_token(token)
 69
 70    def import_ayah_metadata(self, metadata: list[AyahMetadata]) -> None:
 71        """Import ayah metadata records."""
 72        for meta in metadata:
 73            self.data_access.insert_ayah_metadata(meta)
 74
 75    def import_manifest(self, manifest: DatasetManifest) -> None:
 76        """Import a complete dataset manifest."""
 77        self.data_access.insert_dataset_manifest(manifest)
 78

 85    ) -> None:

 89        Args:
 90            surahs: List of Surah objects
 91            ayah_texts: List of AyahText objects
 92            edition: TextEdition for this import
 93            dataset_id: Dataset identifier

100
101        # Import ayah texts

class QuranicVocabulary: 
 50class QuranicVocabulary:
 51    """
 52    Qur'anic vocabulary analyzer.
 53
 54    Connects dictionary/lexicon entries to actual Qur'anic occurrences
 55    using the word token and morphological analysis data in the database.
 56    Provides concordance, frequency, and distribution analysis.
 57    """
 58
 59    def __init__(self, data_access: DataAccess | None = None, edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1"):
 60        """
 61        Initialize vocabulary analyzer.
 62
 63        Args:
 64            data_access: DataAccess instance (creates default if None)
 65            edition_id: Text edition to analyze
 66        """
 67        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
 68        self.edition_id = edition_id
 69
 70    def get_occurrences_by_root(
 71        self,
 72        root_form: str,
 73        limit: int = 1000,
 74    ) -> list[QuranicOccurrence]:
 75        """
 76        Get all Qur'anic occurrences of a root.
 77
 78        Uses QAC morphology annotations (token_analysis) linked to word tokens.
 79
 80        Args:
 81            root_form: Arabic root (e.g., "ر ح م" or "رحم")
 82            limit: Maximum occurrences to return
 83
 84        Returns:
 85            List of QuranicOccurrence objects
 86        """
 87        # Normalize root for matching
 88        root_norm = root_form.replace(" ", "")
 89
 90        # Query token_analysis joined with word_token to get occurrences
 91        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
 92            SELECT
 93                ta.root_id,
 94                ta.lemma_id,
 95                ta.part_of_speech,
 96                wt.token_id,
 97                wt.surah_number,
 98                wt.ayah_number,
 99                wt.token_index,
100                wt.surface_original,
101                at.text_original as ayah_text
102            FROM token_analysis ta
103            JOIN word_token wt ON wt.token_id = ta.token_id
104            JOIN ayah_text at ON at.edition_id = wt.edition_id
105                AND at.surah_number = wt.surah_number
106                AND at.ayah_number = wt.ayah_number
107            WHERE ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
108              AND wt.edition_id = ?
109              AND (ta.root_id LIKE ? OR ta.root_id LIKE ?)
110            ORDER BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number, wt.token_index
111            LIMIT ?
112        """, (self.edition_id, f"%{root_norm}%", f"%{root_form.replace(' ', '_')}%", limit))
113
114        occurrences = []
115        for row in rows:
116            # Extract root form from root_id
117            root_id = row["root_id"]
118            extracted_root = root_id.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") if root_id else None
119
120            # Extract lemma form from lemma_id
121            lemma_id = row["lemma_id"]
122            extracted_lemma = lemma_id.replace("qac-lemma:", "") if lemma_id else None
123
124            occurrences.append(QuranicOccurrence(
125                surah_number=row["surah_number"],
126                ayah_number=row["ayah_number"],
127                token_index=row["token_index"],
128                surface_form=row["surface_original"],
129                root_form=extracted_root,
130                lemma_form=extracted_lemma,
131                part_of_speech=row["part_of_speech"],
132                edition_id=self.edition_id,
133                token_id=row["token_id"],
134                ayah_text=row["ayah_text"],
135            ))
136
137        return occurrences
138
139    def get_occurrences_by_lemma(
140        self,
141        lemma_form: str,
142        limit: int = 1000,
143    ) -> list[QuranicOccurrence]:
144        """
145        Get all Qur'anic occurrences of a lemma.
146
147        Args:
148            lemma_form: Arabic lemma (e.g., "رحمة", "رحمن")
149            limit: Maximum occurrences to return
150
151        Returns:
152            List of QuranicOccurrence objects
153        """
154        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
155            SELECT
156                ta.root_id,
157                ta.lemma_id,
158                ta.part_of_speech,
159                wt.token_id,
160                wt.surah_number,
161                wt.ayah_number,
162                wt.token_index,
163                wt.surface_original,
164                at.text_original as ayah_text
165            FROM token_analysis ta
166            JOIN word_token wt ON wt.token_id = ta.token_id
167            JOIN ayah_text at ON at.edition_id = wt.edition_id
168                AND at.surah_number = wt.surah_number
169                AND at.ayah_number = wt.ayah_number
170            WHERE ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
171              AND wt.edition_id = ?
172              AND ta.lemma_id LIKE ?
173            ORDER BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number, wt.token_index
174            LIMIT ?
175        """, (self.edition_id, f"%{lemma_form}%", limit))
176
177        occurrences = []
178        for row in rows:
179            root_id = row["root_id"]
180            extracted_root = root_id.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") if root_id else None
181
182            lemma_id = row["lemma_id"]
183            extracted_lemma = lemma_id.replace("qac-lemma:", "") if lemma_id else None
184
185            occurrences.append(QuranicOccurrence(
186                surah_number=row["surah_number"],
187                ayah_number=row["ayah_number"],
188                token_index=row["token_index"],
189                surface_form=row["surface_original"],
190                root_form=extracted_root,
191                lemma_form=extracted_lemma,
192                part_of_speech=row["part_of_speech"],
193                edition_id=self.edition_id,
194                token_id=row["token_id"],
195                ayah_text=row["ayah_text"],
196            ))
197
198        return occurrences
199
200    def get_occurrences_by_surface(
201        self,
202        surface_form: str,
203        limit: int = 1000,
204    ) -> list[QuranicOccurrence]:
205        """
206        Get all Qur'anic occurrences of a surface form (exact word).
207
208        Args:
209            surface_form: Exact Arabic word form
210            limit: Maximum occurrences to return
211
212        Returns:
213            List of QuranicOccurrence objects
214        """
215        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
216            SELECT
217                wt.token_id,
218                wt.surah_number,
219                wt.ayah_number,
220                wt.token_index,
221                wt.surface_original,
222                at.text_original as ayah_text,
223                ta.root_id,
224                ta.lemma_id,
225                ta.part_of_speech
226            FROM word_token wt
227            JOIN ayah_text at ON at.edition_id = wt.edition_id
228                AND at.surah_number = wt.surah_number
229                AND at.ayah_number = wt.ayah_number
230            LEFT JOIN token_analysis ta ON ta.token_id = wt.token_id
231                AND ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
232            WHERE wt.edition_id = ?
233              AND wt.surface_original = ?
234            ORDER BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number, wt.token_index
235            LIMIT ?
236        """, (self.edition_id, surface_form, limit))
237
238        occurrences = []
239        for row in rows:
240            root_id = row["root_id"]
241            extracted_root = root_id.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") if root_id else None
242
243            lemma_id = row["lemma_id"]
244            extracted_lemma = lemma_id.replace("qac-lemma:", "") if lemma_id else None
245
246            occurrences.append(QuranicOccurrence(
247                surah_number=row["surah_number"],
248                ayah_number=row["ayah_number"],
249                token_index=row["token_index"],
250                surface_form=row["surface_original"],
251                root_form=extracted_root,
252                lemma_form=extracted_lemma,
253                part_of_speech=row["part_of_speech"],
254                edition_id=self.edition_id,
255                token_id=row["token_id"],
256                ayah_text=row["ayah_text"],
257            ))
258
259        return occurrences
260
261    def get_vocabulary_stats(
262        self,
263        root_form: str | None = None,
264        lemma_form: str | None = None,
265        surface_form: str | None = None,
266    ) -> VocabularyStats:
267        """
268        Get comprehensive statistics for a root, lemma, or surface form.
269
270        Args:
271            root_form: Arabic root
272            lemma_form: Arabic lemma
273            surface_form: Exact surface form
274
275        Returns:
276            VocabularyStats with frequency, distribution, etc.
277        """
278        occurrences = []
279
280        if root_form:
281            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_root(root_form)
282        elif lemma_form:
283            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_lemma(lemma_form)
284        elif surface_form:
285            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_surface(surface_form)
286        else:
287            return VocabularyStats()
288
289        if not occurrences:
290            return VocabularyStats(
291                root_form=root_form,
292                lemma_form=lemma_form,
293                surface_form=surface_form,
294            )
295
296        # Calculate statistics
297        total = len(occurrences)
298        surahs = {o.surah_number for o in occurrences}
299        ayahs = {(o.surah_number, o.ayah_number) for o in occurrences}
300
301        # Surah distribution
302        surah_dist: dict[int, int] = {}
303        for occ in occurrences:
304            surah_dist[occ.surah_number] = surah_dist.get(occ.surah_number, 0) + 1
305
306        # Juz distribution (requires metadata)
307        juz_dist: dict[int, int] = {}
308        for occ in occurrences:
309            # Get juz from ayah_metadata
310            juz_rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
311                SELECT value_text FROM ayah_metadata
312                WHERE surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ? AND metadata_type = 'juz'
313                LIMIT 1
314            """, (occ.surah_number, occ.ayah_number))
315            if juz_rows:
316                try:
317                    juz = int(juz_rows[0]["value_text"])
318                    juz_dist[juz] = juz_dist.get(juz, 0) + 1
319                except (ValueError, TypeError):
320                    pass
321
322        first = occurrences[0]
323        last = occurrences[-1]
324
325        stats = VocabularyStats(
326            root_form=root_form,
327            lemma_form=lemma_form,
328            surface_form=surface_form,
329            total_occurrences=total,
330            unique_surahs=len(surahs),
331            unique_ayahs=len(ayahs),
332            first_occurrence=first,
333            last_occurrence=last,
334            surah_distribution=surah_dist,
335            juz_distribution=juz_dist if juz_dist else None,
336        )
337
338        return stats
339
340    def get_concordance(
341        self,
342        root_form: str | None = None,
343        lemma_form: str | None = None,
344        surface_form: str | None = None,
345        context_words: int = 3,
346        limit: int = 100,
347    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
348        """
349        Get concordance lines for a root, lemma, or surface form.
350
351        Returns each occurrence with surrounding context words.
352
353        Args:
354            root_form: Arabic root
355            lemma_form: Arabic lemma
356            surface_form: Exact surface form
357            context_words: Number of words before/after to include
358            limit: Maximum concordance lines
359
360        Returns:
361            List of concordance line dictionaries
362        """
363        occurrences = []
364
365        if root_form:
366            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_root(root_form, limit)
367        elif lemma_form:
368            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_lemma(lemma_form, limit)
369        elif surface_form:
370            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_surface(surface_form, limit)
371        else:
372            return []
373
374        concordance = []
375
376        for occ in occurrences[:limit]:
377            # Get surrounding tokens
378            context_rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
379                SELECT token_index, surface_original
380                FROM word_token
381                WHERE edition_id = ? AND surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?
382                  AND token_index BETWEEN ? AND ?
383                ORDER BY token_index
384            """, (
385                self.edition_id,
386                occ.surah_number,
387                occ.ayah_number,
388                max(0, occ.token_index - context_words),
389                occ.token_index + context_words,
390            ))
391
392            context = [
393                {"index": r["token_index"], "form": r["surface_original"]}
394                for r in context_rows
395            ]
396
397            concordance.append({
398                "reference": f"{occ.surah_number}:{occ.ayah_number}",
399                "surah_number": occ.surah_number,
400                "ayah_number": occ.ayah_number,
401                "token_index": occ.token_index,
402                "target_form": occ.surface_form,
403                "root_form": occ.root_form,
404                "lemma_form": occ.lemma_form,

def get_occurrences_by_root( self, root_form: str, limit: int = 1000) -> list[qurankit.lexicon.vocabulary.QuranicOccurrence]: 
 70    def get_occurrences_by_root(
 71        self,
 72        root_form: str,
 73        limit: int = 1000,
 74    ) -> list[QuranicOccurrence]:
 75        """
 76        Get all Qur'anic occurrences of a root.
 77
 78        Uses QAC morphology annotations (token_analysis) linked to word tokens.
 79
 80        Args:
 81            root_form: Arabic root (e.g., "ر ح م" or "رحم")
 82            limit: Maximum occurrences to return
 83
 84        Returns:
 85            List of QuranicOccurrence objects
 86        """
 87        # Normalize root for matching
 88        root_norm = root_form.replace(" ", "")
 89
 90        # Query token_analysis joined with word_token to get occurrences
 91        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
 92            SELECT
 93                ta.root_id,
 94                ta.lemma_id,
 95                ta.part_of_speech,
 96                wt.token_id,
 97                wt.surah_number,
 98                wt.ayah_number,
 99                wt.token_index,
100                wt.surface_original,
101                at.text_original as ayah_text
102            FROM token_analysis ta
103            JOIN word_token wt ON wt.token_id = ta.token_id
104            JOIN ayah_text at ON at.edition_id = wt.edition_id
105                AND at.surah_number = wt.surah_number
106                AND at.ayah_number = wt.ayah_number
107            WHERE ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
108              AND wt.edition_id = ?
109              AND (ta.root_id LIKE ? OR ta.root_id LIKE ?)
110            ORDER BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number, wt.token_index
111            LIMIT ?
112        """, (self.edition_id, f"%{root_norm}%", f"%{root_form.replace(' ', '_')}%", limit))
113
114        occurrences = []
115        for row in rows:
116            # Extract root form from root_id
117            root_id = row["root_id"]
118            extracted_root = root_id.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") if root_id else None
119
120            # Extract lemma form from lemma_id
121            lemma_id = row["lemma_id"]
122            extracted_lemma = lemma_id.replace("qac-lemma:", "") if lemma_id else None
123
124            occurrences.append(QuranicOccurrence(
125                surah_number=row["surah_number"],
126                ayah_number=row["ayah_number"],
127                token_index=row["token_index"],
128                surface_form=row["surface_original"],
129                root_form=extracted_root,
130                lemma_form=extracted_lemma,
131                part_of_speech=row["part_of_speech"],
132                edition_id=self.edition_id,
133                token_id=row["token_id"],
134                ayah_text=row["ayah_text"],
135            ))
136
137        return occurrences

def get_vocabulary_stats( self, root_form: str | None = None, lemma_form: str | None = None, surface_form: str | None = None) -> qurankit.lexicon.vocabulary.VocabularyStats: 
261    def get_vocabulary_stats(
262        self,
263        root_form: str | None = None,
264        lemma_form: str | None = None,
265        surface_form: str | None = None,
266    ) -> VocabularyStats:
267        """
268        Get comprehensive statistics for a root, lemma, or surface form.
269
270        Args:
271            root_form: Arabic root
272            lemma_form: Arabic lemma
273            surface_form: Exact surface form
274
275        Returns:
276            VocabularyStats with frequency, distribution, etc.
277        """
278        occurrences = []
279
280        if root_form:
281            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_root(root_form)
282        elif lemma_form:
283            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_lemma(lemma_form)
284        elif surface_form:
285            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_surface(surface_form)
286        else:
287            return VocabularyStats()
288
289        if not occurrences:
290            return VocabularyStats(
291                root_form=root_form,
292                lemma_form=lemma_form,
293                surface_form=surface_form,
294            )
295
296        # Calculate statistics
297        total = len(occurrences)
298        surahs = {o.surah_number for o in occurrences}
299        ayahs = {(o.surah_number, o.ayah_number) for o in occurrences}
300
301        # Surah distribution
302        surah_dist: dict[int, int] = {}
303        for occ in occurrences:
304            surah_dist[occ.surah_number] = surah_dist.get(occ.surah_number, 0) + 1
305
306        # Juz distribution (requires metadata)
307        juz_dist: dict[int, int] = {}
308        for occ in occurrences:
309            # Get juz from ayah_metadata
310            juz_rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
311                SELECT value_text FROM ayah_metadata
312                WHERE surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ? AND metadata_type = 'juz'
313                LIMIT 1
314            """, (occ.surah_number, occ.ayah_number))
315            if juz_rows:
316                try:
317                    juz = int(juz_rows[0]["value_text"])
318                    juz_dist[juz] = juz_dist.get(juz, 0) + 1
319                except (ValueError, TypeError):
320                    pass
321
322        first = occurrences[0]
323        last = occurrences[-1]
324
325        stats = VocabularyStats(
326            root_form=root_form,
327            lemma_form=lemma_form,
328            surface_form=surface_form,
329            total_occurrences=total,
330            unique_surahs=len(surahs),
331            unique_ayahs=len(ayahs),
332            first_occurrence=first,
333            last_occurrence=last,
334            surah_distribution=surah_dist,
335            juz_distribution=juz_dist if juz_dist else None,
336        )
337
338        return stats

Args: root_form: Arabic root lemma_form: Arabic lemma surface_form: Exact surface form

Returns: VocabularyStats with frequency, distribution, etc.

def get_concordance( self, root_form: str | None = None, lemma_form: str | None = None, surface_form: str | None = None, context_words: int = 3, limit: int = 100) -> list[dict[str, typing.Any]]: 
340    def get_concordance(
341        self,
342        root_form: str | None = None,
343        lemma_form: str | None = None,
344        surface_form: str | None = None,
345        context_words: int = 3,
346        limit: int = 100,
347    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
348        """
349        Get concordance lines for a root, lemma, or surface form.
350
351        Returns each occurrence with surrounding context words.
352
353        Args:
354            root_form: Arabic root
355            lemma_form: Arabic lemma
356            surface_form: Exact surface form
357            context_words: Number of words before/after to include
358            limit: Maximum concordance lines
359
360        Returns:
361            List of concordance line dictionaries
362        """
363        occurrences = []
364
365        if root_form:
366            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_root(root_form, limit)
367        elif lemma_form:
368            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_lemma(lemma_form, limit)
369        elif surface_form:
370            occurrences = self.get_occurrences_by_surface(surface_form, limit)
371        else:
372            return []
373
374        concordance = []
375
376        for occ in occurrences[:limit]:
377            # Get surrounding tokens
378            context_rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall("""
379                SELECT token_index, surface_original
380                FROM word_token
381                WHERE edition_id = ? AND surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?
382                  AND token_index BETWEEN ? AND ?
383                ORDER BY token_index
384            """, (
385                self.edition_id,
386                occ.surah_number,
387                occ.ayah_number,
388                max(0, occ.token_index - context_words),
389                occ.token_index + context_words,
390            ))
391
392            context = [
393                {"index": r["token_index"], "form": r["surface_original"]}
394                for r in context_rows
395            ]
396
397            concordance.append({
398                "reference": f"{occ.surah_number}:{occ.ayah_number}",
399                "surah_number": occ.surah_number,
400                "ayah_number": occ.ayah_number,
401                "token_index": occ.token_index,
402                "target_form": occ.surface_form,
403                "root_form": occ.root_form,
404                "lemma_form": occ.lemma_form,
405                "part_of_speech": occ.part_of_speech,
406                "ayah_text": occ.ayah_text,
407                "context": context,
408            })
409
410        return concordance

class DictionaryAdapter(abc.ABC): 
 49class DictionaryAdapter(ABC):
 50    """
 51    Abstract base class for dictionary adapters.
 52
 53    All dictionary providers must implement this interface to integrate
 54    with QuranKit's lexicon layer. The adapter is responsible for:
 55    - Providing resource metadata (LexicalResource)
 56    - Looking up entries by root, lemma, or headword
 57    - Returning senses with definitions and provenance
 58    - Supporting Qur'anic occurrence lists when available
 59
 60    Implementations must preserve source attribution for every returned
 61    record and must not fabricate or infer data not present in the source.
 62    """
 63
 64    @property
 65    @abstractmethod
 66    def resource_id(self) -> str:
 67        """Unique identifier for this lexical resource (e.g., 'lane-lexicon', 'mufradat')."""
 68
 69    @property
 70    @abstractmethod
 71    def resource_title(self) -> str:
 72        """Human-readable title of the lexical resource."""
 73
 74    @property
 75    @abstractmethod
 76    def capabilities(self) -> AdapterCapabilities:
 77        """Capabilities supported by this adapter."""
 78
 79    @abstractmethod
 80    def get_resource_metadata(self) -> LexicalResource:
 81        """
 82        Get the LexicalResource metadata for this adapter.
 83
 84        Returns:
 85            LexicalResource with title, author, edition, language, scope, etc.
 86        """
 87
 88    @abstractmethod
 89    def lookup_by_root(self, root_form: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
 90        """
 91        Look up lexical entries by Arabic root.
 92
 93        Args:
 94            root_form: Arabic root (e.g., "ر ح م" or "رحم")
 95            limit: Maximum number of entries to return
 96
 97        Returns:
 98            LexicalLookupResult with matching entries and senses
 99        """
100
101    @abstractmethod
102    def lookup_by_lemma(self, lemma_form: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
103        """
104        Look up lexical entries by lemma (citation form).
105
106        Args:
107            lemma_form: Arabic lemma (e.g., "رحمة" or "رحمن")
108            limit: Maximum number of entries to return
109
110        Returns:
111            LexicalLookupResult with matching entries and senses
112        """
113
114    @abstractmethod
115    def lookup_by_headword(self, headword: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
116        """
117        Look up lexical entries by headword (exact or prefix match).
118
119        Args:
120            headword: Arabic headword to search
121            limit: Maximum number of entries to return
122
123        Returns:
124            LexicalLookupResult with matching entries and senses
125        """
126
127    @abstractmethod
128    def get_senses_for_entry(self, lexical_entry_id: str) -> list[LexicalSense]:
129        """
130        Get all senses for a specific lexical entry.
131
132        Args:
133            lexical_entry_id: Internal ID of the lexical entry
134
135        Returns:
136            List of LexicalSense objects
137        """
138
139    def get_quranic_occurrences(self, root_form: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
140        """
141        Get Qur'anic occurrences for a root (optional).
142
143        Returns a list of occurrence records with surah, ayah, word position,
144        and surface form. Only implemented if the source provides this data.
145
146        Args:
147            root_form: Arabic root
148
149        Returns:
150            List of occurrence dictionaries
151        """
152        return []
153
154    def get_semantic_relations(self, lexical_entry_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
155        """
156        Get semantic relations for a lexical entry (optional).
157
158        Returns relations like synonyms, antonyms, hypernyms, etc.
159        Only implemented if the source provides this data.
160
161        Args:
162            lexical_entry_id: Internal ID of the lexical entry
163
164        Returns:
165            List of relation dictionaries with type, target, and evidence
166        """
167        return []
168
169    def get_examples(self, lexical_entry_id: str) -> list[str]:
170        """
171        Get usage examples for a lexical entry (optional).
172
173        Only implemented if the source provides examples.
174
175        Args:
176            lexical_entry_id: Internal ID of the lexical entry
177
178        Returns:
179            List of example strings
180        """
181        return []
182
183    def search(
184        self,
185        query: str,
186        mode: str = "prefix",
187        limit: int = 50,
188    ) -> LexicalLookupResult:
189        """
190        General search across headwords, roots, and lemmas.
191
192        Default implementation dispatches to headword lookup. Override
193        for more sophisticated search.
194
195        Args:
196            query: Search query
197            mode: Search mode (prefix, exact, contains)
198            limit: Maximum results
199
200        Returns:
201            LexicalLookupResult
202        """
203        return self.lookup_by_headword(query, limit)
204
205    def close(self) -> None:
206        """Close any open connections or resources."""
207        pass
208
209    def __enter__(self) -> DictionaryAdapter:
210        return self
211
212    def __exit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any) -> None:
213        self.close()

Abstract base class for dictionary adapters.

All dictionary providers must implement this interface to integrate with QuranKit's lexicon layer. The adapter is responsible for:

  • Providing resource metadata (LexicalResource)
  • Looking up entries by root, lemma, or headword
  • Returning senses with definitions and provenance
  • Supporting Qur'anic occurrence lists when available

Implementations must preserve source attribution for every returned record and must not fabricate or infer data not present in the source.
