class FileBasedDictionaryAdapter(qurankit.DictionaryAdapter): 
 26class FileBasedDictionaryAdapter(DictionaryAdapter):
 27    """
 28    Dictionary adapter that loads from local JSONL or SQLite files.
 29
 30    Supports loading lexical resources from structured files with
 31    proper provenance tracking. Designed for public domain or
 32    openly licensed dictionary data that users provide locally.
 33    """
 34
 35    def __init__(
 36        self,
 37        resource_id: str,
 38        resource_title: str,
 39        data_path: Path,
 40        source: Source,
 41        capabilities: AdapterCapabilities | None = None,
 42    ):
 43        """
 44        Initialize file-based dictionary adapter.
 45
 46        Args:
 47            resource_id: Unique identifier (e.g., "lane-lexicon")
 48            resource_title: Human-readable title
 49            data_path: Path to data file (JSONL or SQLite)
 50            source: Source provenance object
 51            capabilities: Adapter capabilities (auto-detected if None)
 52        """
 53        self._resource_id = resource_id
 54        self._resource_title = resource_title
 55        self._data_path = Path(data_path)
 56        self._source = source
 57        self._capabilities = capabilities or AdapterCapabilities()
 58        self._db: sqlite3.Connection | None = None
 59        self._resource_metadata: LexicalResource | None = None
 60        self._initialized = False
 61
 62    @property
 63    def resource_id(self) -> str:
 64        return self._resource_id
 65
 66    @property
 67    def resource_title(self) -> str:
 68        return self._resource_title
 69
 70    @property
 71    def capabilities(self) -> AdapterCapabilities:
 72        return self._capabilities
 73
 74    def _initialize(self) -> None:
 75        """Lazy initialization of database connection and metadata."""
 76        if self._initialized:
 77            return
 78
 79        if not self._data_path.exists():
 80            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Dictionary data not found: {self._data_path}")
 81
 82        if self._data_path.suffix in {".db", ".sqlite", ".sqlite3"}:
 83            self._db = sqlite3.connect(self._data_path)
 84            self._db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
 85            self._init_sqlite_schema()
 86        else:
 87            # JSONL format - load into memory SQLite
 88            self._db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
 89            self._db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
 90            self._load_jsonl()
 91
 92        # Create resource metadata
 93        self._resource_metadata = LexicalResource(
 94            lexical_resource_id=self._resource_id,
 95            dataset_id=f"lexicon-{self._resource_id}",
 96            title=self._resource_title,
 97            author=self._source.creator,
 98            edition=getattr(self._source, "edition", None),
 99            language="ar",
100            scope="general_arabic",
101            notes=f"Loaded from {self._data_path.name}",
102        )
103
104        self._initialized = True
105
106    def _init_sqlite_schema(self) -> None:
107        """Initialize SQLite schema for dictionary data."""
108        cursor = self._db.cursor()
109        cursor.execute("""
110            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lexical_entry (
111                entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
112                headword_original TEXT NOT NULL,
113                headword_normalized TEXT,
114                root_form TEXT,
115                root_normalized TEXT,
116                entry_text_original TEXT,
117                entry_location TEXT,
118                metadata_json TEXT
119            )
120        """)
121        cursor.execute("""
122            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lexical_sense (
123                sense_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
124                entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
125                sense_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
126                definition_original TEXT NOT NULL,
127                definition_language TEXT,
128                grammatical_info TEXT,
129                usage_examples_json TEXT,
130                semantic_domain TEXT,
131                metadata_json TEXT
132            )
133        """)
134        cursor.execute("""
135            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS root (
136                root_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
137                root_form TEXT NOT NULL,
138                root_normalized TEXT,
139                notes TEXT
140            )
141        """)
142        cursor.execute("""
143            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lemma (
144                lemma_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
145                lemma_form TEXT NOT NULL,
146                lemma_normalized TEXT,
147                language TEXT DEFAULT 'ar',
148                notes TEXT
149            )
150        """)
151        # Indexes
152        cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_entry_headword ON lexical_entry(headword_normalized)")
153        cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_entry_root ON lexical_entry(root_form)")
154        cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_entry_root_norm ON lexical_entry(root_normalized)")
155        cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sense_entry ON lexical_sense(entry_id)")
156        self._db.commit()
157
158    def _load_jsonl(self) -> None:
159        """Load JSONL data into memory SQLite."""
160        self._init_sqlite_schema()
161        cursor = self._db.cursor()
162
163        with open(self._data_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
164            for line_num, line in enumerate(f, 1):
165                line = line.strip()
166                if not line:
167                    continue
168                try:
169                    record = json.loads(line)
170                    self._insert_record(cursor, record)
171                except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
172                    raise ValueError(f"Invalid JSON at line {line_num}: {e}")
173
174        self._db.commit()
175
176    def _insert_record(self, cursor: sqlite3.Cursor, record: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
177        """Insert a dictionary record from JSONL."""
178        # Required fields
179        entry_id = record.get("entry_id") or record.get("id")
180        headword = record.get("headword") or record.get("headword_original")
181        if not entry_id or not headword:
182            return
183
184        # Optional fields
185        root_form = record.get("root_form") or record.get("root")
186        lemma_form = record.get("lemma_form") or record.get("lemma")
187        entry_text = record.get("entry_text") or record.get("entry_text_original")
188        location = record.get("location") or record.get("entry_location")
189
190        # Normalize for search
191        headword_norm = headword.replace("\u064e", "").replace("\u064f", "").replace("\u0650", "").replace("\u0651", "").replace("\u0670", "").replace("\u0652", "")
192        root_norm = root_form.replace(" ", "").replace("\u064e", "").replace("\u064f", "").replace("\u0650", "").replace("\u0651", "").replace("\u0670", "").replace("\u0652", "") if root_form else None
193
194        cursor.execute("""
195            INSERT OR REPLACE INTO lexical_entry
196            (entry_id, headword_original, headword_normalized, root_form, root_normalized, entry_text_original, entry_location, metadata_json)
197            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
198        """, (entry_id, headword, headword_norm, root_form, root_norm, entry_text, location, json.dumps(record.get("metadata"))))
199
200        # Insert senses
201        senses = record.get("senses") or record.get("definitions") or []
202        for i, sense in enumerate(senses):
203            sense_id = sense.get("sense_id") or f"{entry_id}:{i + 1}"
204            definition = sense.get("definition") or sense.get("definition_original")
205            if not definition:
206                continue
207
208            lang = sense.get("language") or sense.get("definition_language") or "ar"
209            grammatical = sense.get("grammatical_info") or sense.get("pos")
210            examples = sense.get("examples") or sense.get("usage_examples")
211            domain = sense.get("semantic_domain") or sense.get("domain")
212
213            cursor.execute("""
214                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO lexical_sense
215                (sense_id, entry_id, sense_number, definition_original, definition_language, grammatical_info, usage_examples_json, semantic_domain, metadata_json)
216                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
217            """, (sense_id, entry_id, i + 1, definition, lang, grammatical, json.dumps(examples) if examples else None, domain, json.dumps(sense.get("metadata"))))
218
219        # Insert root if present
220        if root_form:
221            root_id = f"root:{root_form.replace(' ', '_')}"
222            cursor.execute("""
223                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO root (root_id, root_form, root_normalized)
224                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
225            """, (root_id, root_form, root_norm))
226
227        # Insert lemma if present
228        if lemma_form:
229            lemma_id = f"lemma:{lemma_form}"
230            cursor.execute("""
231                INSERT OR REPLACE INTO lemma (lemma_id, lemma_form, lemma_normalized)
232                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
233            """, (lemma_id, lemma_form, lemma_form))
234
235    def get_resource_metadata(self) -> LexicalResource:
236        self._initialize()
237        return self._resource_metadata
238
239    def lookup_by_root(self, root_form: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
240        self._initialize()
241        cursor = self._db.cursor()
242
243        # Normalize root for search
244        root_norm = root_form.replace(" ", "").replace("\u064e", "").replace("\u064f", "").replace("\u0650", "").replace("\u0651", "").replace("\u0670", "").replace("\u0652", "")
245
246        # Search by root_form or root_normalized
247        cursor.execute("""
248            SELECT * FROM lexical_entry
249            WHERE root_form = ? OR root_form LIKE ? OR root_normalized = ?
250            LIMIT ?
251        """, (root_form, f"{root_form}%", root_norm, limit))
252
253        entries = []
254        entry_ids = []
255        for row in cursor.fetchall():
256            entry = LexicalEntry(
257                lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
258                lexical_resource_id=self._resource_id,
259                source_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
260                headword_original=row["headword_original"],
261                headword_normalized=row["headword_normalized"],
262                root_form=row["root_form"],
263                entry_text_original=row["entry_text_original"],
264                entry_location=row["entry_location"],
265                metadata_json=json.loads(row["metadata_json"]) if row["metadata_json"] else None,
266            )
267            entries.append(entry)
268            entry_ids.append(row["entry_id"])
269
270        # Get senses for these entries
271        senses = []
272        if entry_ids:
273            placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(entry_ids))
274            cursor.execute(f"""
275                SELECT * FROM lexical_sense
276                WHERE entry_id IN ({placeholders})
277                ORDER BY entry_id, sense_number
278            """, entry_ids)
279            for row in cursor.fetchall():
280                sense = LexicalSense(
281                    sense_id=row["sense_id"],
282                    lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
283                    sense_number=row["sense_number"],
284                    definition_original=row["definition_original"],
285                    definition_language=row["definition_language"] or "ar",
286                    grammatical_info=row["grammatical_info"],
287                    usage_examples_original=json.loads(row["usage_examples_json"]) if row["usage_examples_json"] else None,
288                    semantic_domain=row["semantic_domain"],
289                    metadata_json=json.loads(row["metadata_json"]) if row["metadata_json"] else None,
290                )
291                senses.append(sense)
292
293        # Get root
294        root_obj = None
295        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM root WHERE root_form = ? OR root_normalized = ?", (root_form, root_norm))
296        row = cursor.fetchone()
297        if row:
298            root_obj = Root(
299                root_id=row["root_id"],
300                root_form=row["root_form"],
301                root_normalized=row["root_normalized"],
302                notes=row["notes"],
303            )
304
305        roots = [root_obj] if root_obj else []
306
307        return LexicalLookupResult(
308            resource=self._resource_metadata,
309            entries=entries,
310            senses=senses,
311            roots=roots,
312            lemmas=[],
313        )
314
315    def lookup_by_lemma(self, lemma_form: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
316        self._initialize()
317        cursor = self._db.cursor()
318
319        cursor.execute("""
320            SELECT * FROM lexical_entry
321            WHERE headword_original = ? OR headword_normalized = ? OR root_form = ?
322            LIMIT ?
323        """, (lemma_form, lemma_form, lemma_form, limit))
324
325        entries = []
326        entry_ids = []
327        for row in cursor.fetchall():
328            entry = LexicalEntry(
329                lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
330                lexical_resource_id=self._resource_id,
331                source_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
332                headword_original=row["headword_original"],
333                headword_normalized=row["headword_normalized"],
334                root_form=row["root_form"],
335                entry_text_original=row["entry_text_original"],
336                entry_location=row["entry_location"],
337                metadata_json=json.loads(row["metadata_json"]) if row["metadata_json"] else None,
338            )
339            entries.append(entry)
340            entry_ids.append(row["entry_id"])
341
342        senses = []
343        if entry_ids:
344            placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(entry_ids))
345            cursor.execute(f"""
346                SELECT * FROM lexical_sense
347                WHERE entry_id IN ({placeholders})
348                ORDER BY entry_id, sense_number
349            """, entry_ids)
350            for row in cursor.fetchall():
351                sense = LexicalSense(
352                    sense_id=row["sense_id"],
353                    lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
354                    sense_number=row["sense_number"],
355                    definition_original=row["definition_original"],
356                    definition_language=row["definition_language"] or "ar",
357                    grammatical_info=row["grammatical_info"],
358                    usage_examples_original=json.loads(row["usage_examples_json"]) if row["usage_examples_json"] else None,
359                    semantic_domain=row["semantic_domain"],
360                    metadata_json=json.loads(row["metadata_json"]) if row["metadata_json"] else None,
361                )
362                senses.append(sense)
363
364        # Get lemma
365        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM lemma WHERE lemma_form = ?", (lemma_form,))
366        row = cursor.fetchone()
367        lemmas = []
368        if row:
369            lemmas.append(Lemma(
370                lemma_id=row["lemma_id"],
371                lemma_form=row["lemma_form"],
372                lemma_normalized=row["lemma_normalized"],
373                language=row["language"],
374                notes=row["notes"],
375            ))
376
377        return LexicalLookupResult(
378            resource=self._resource_metadata,
379            entries=entries,
380            senses=senses,
381            roots=[],
382            lemmas=lemmas,
383        )
384
385    def lookup_by_headword(self, headword: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
386        self._initialize()
387        cursor = self._db.cursor()
388
389        # Normalize headword for search
390        headword_norm = headword.replace("\u064e", "").replace("\u064f", "").replace("\u0650", "").replace("\u0651", "").replace("\u0670", "").replace("\u0652", "")
391
392        # Try exact match first, then prefix
393        cursor.execute("""
394            SELECT * FROM lexical_entry
395            WHERE headword_original = ? OR headword_normalized = ?
396            LIMIT ?
397        """, (headword, headword_norm, limit))
398
399        rows = cursor.fetchall()
400        if len(rows) < limit:
401            cursor.execute("""
402                SELECT * FROM lexical_entry
403                WHERE headword_normalized LIKE ?
404                AND headword_original != ? AND headword_normalized != ?
405                LIMIT ?
406            """, (f"{headword_norm}%", headword, headword_norm, limit - len(rows)))
407            rows.extend(cursor.fetchall())
408
409        entries = []
410        entry_ids = []
411        for row in rows:
412            entry = LexicalEntry(
413                lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
414                lexical_resource_id=self._resource_id,
415                source_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
416                headword_original=row["headword_original"],

def lookup_by_root( self, root_form: str, limit: int = 50) -> qurankit.lexicon.adapter.LexicalLookupResult: 
239    def lookup_by_root(self, root_form: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
240        self._initialize()
241        cursor = self._db.cursor()
242
243        # Normalize root for search
244        root_norm = root_form.replace(" ", "").replace("\u064e", "").replace("\u064f", "").replace("\u0650", "").replace("\u0651", "").replace("\u0670", "").replace("\u0652", "")
245
246        # Search by root_form or root_normalized
247        cursor.execute("""
248            SELECT * FROM lexical_entry
249            WHERE root_form = ? OR root_form LIKE ? OR root_normalized = ?
250            LIMIT ?
251        """, (root_form, f"{root_form}%", root_norm, limit))
252
253        entries = []
254        entry_ids = []
255        for row in cursor.fetchall():
256            entry = LexicalEntry(
257                lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
258                lexical_resource_id=self._resource_id,
259                source_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
260                headword_original=row["headword_original"],
261                headword_normalized=row["headword_normalized"],
262                root_form=row["root_form"],
263                entry_text_original=row["entry_text_original"],
264                entry_location=row["entry_location"],
265                metadata_json=json.loads(row["metadata_json"]) if row["metadata_json"] else None,
266            )
267            entries.append(entry)
268            entry_ids.append(row["entry_id"])
269
270        # Get senses for these entries
271        senses = []
272        if entry_ids:
273            placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(entry_ids))
274            cursor.execute(f"""
275                SELECT * FROM lexical_sense
276                WHERE entry_id IN ({placeholders})
277                ORDER BY entry_id, sense_number
278            """, entry_ids)
279            for row in cursor.fetchall():
280                sense = LexicalSense(
281                    sense_id=row["sense_id"],
282                    lexical_entry_id=row["entry_id"],
283                    sense_number=row["sense_number"],
284                    definition_original=row["definition_original"],
285                    definition_language=row["definition_language"] or "ar",
286                    grammatical_info=row["grammatical_info"],
287                    usage_examples_original=json.loads(row["usage_examples_json"]) if row["usage_examples_json"] else None,
288                    semantic_domain=row["semantic_domain"],
289                    metadata_json=json.loads(row["metadata_json"]) if row["metadata_json"] else None,
290                )
291                senses.append(sense)
292
293        # Get root
294        root_obj = None
295        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM root WHERE root_form = ? OR root_normalized = ?", (root_form, root_norm))
296        row = cursor.fetchone()
297        if row:
298            root_obj = Root(
299                root_id=row["root_id"],
300                root_form=row["root_form"],
301                root_normalized=row["root_normalized"],
302                notes=row["notes"],
303            )
304
305        roots = [root_obj] if root_obj else []
306
307        return LexicalLookupResult(
308            resource=self._resource_metadata,
309            entries=entries,
310            senses=senses,
311            roots=roots,
312            lemmas=[],
313        )

385    def lookup_by_headword(self, headword: str, limit: int = 50) -> LexicalLookupResult:
386        self._initialize()

388
389        # Normalize headword for search

391
392        # Try exact match first, then prefix
393        cursor.execute("""
394            SELECT * FROM lexical_entry

396            LIMIT ?
397        """, (headword, headword_norm, limit))
398
399        rows = cursor.fetchall()

404                AND headword_original != ? AND headword_normalized != ?
405                LIMIT ?
406            """, (f"{headword_norm}%", headword, headword_norm, limit - len(rows)))
407            rows.extend(cursor.fetchall())
408
409        entries = []
410        entry_ids = []
411        for row in rows:
412            entry = LexicalEntry(

class DictionaryAdapterRegistry: 
216class DictionaryAdapterRegistry:
217    """
218    Registry for dictionary adapters.
219
220    Manages registration, discovery, and access to dictionary adapters.
221    """
222
223    def __init__(self) -> None:
224        self._adapters: dict[str, DictionaryAdapter] = {}
225        self._resource_metadata: dict[str, LexicalResource] = {}
226
227    def register(self, adapter: DictionaryAdapter) -> None:
228        """
229        Register a dictionary adapter.
230
231        Args:
232            adapter: DictionaryAdapter instance to register
233        """
234        resource = adapter.get_resource_metadata()
235        self._adapters[adapter.resource_id] = adapter
236        self._resource_metadata[adapter.resource_id] = resource
237
238    def unregister(self, resource_id: str) -> bool:
239        """
240        Unregister a dictionary adapter.
241
242        Args:
243            resource_id: Resource ID to unregister
244
245        Returns:
246            True if adapter was found and removed
247        """
248        if resource_id in self._adapters:
249            self._adapters[resource_id].close()
250            del self._adapters[resource_id]
251            del self._resource_metadata[resource_id]
252            return True
253        return False
254
255    def get_adapter(self, resource_id: str) -> DictionaryAdapter | None:
256        """Get an adapter by resource ID."""
257        return self._adapters.get(resource_id)
258
259    def get_resource_metadata(self, resource_id: str) -> LexicalResource | None:
260        """Get resource metadata by resource ID."""
261        return self._resource_metadata.get(resource_id)
262
263    def list_adapters(self) -> list[str]:
264        """List all registered adapter resource IDs."""
265        return list(self._adapters.keys())
266
267    def list_resources(self) -> list[LexicalResource]:
268        """List all registered resource metadata."""
269        return list(self._resource_metadata.values())
270
271    def lookup_root_across_resources(
272        self,
273        root_form: str,
274        limit: int = 50,
275        resource_ids: list[str] | None = None,
276    ) -> dict[str, LexicalLookupResult]:
277        """
278        Look up a root across multiple resources.
279
280        Args:
281            root_form: Arabic root
282            limit: Maximum results per resource
283            resource_ids: Specific resources to search (None = all)
284
285        Returns:
286            Dict mapping resource_id to LexicalLookupResult
287        """
288        results = {}
289        targets = resource_ids or list(self._adapters.keys())
290        for rid in targets:
291            adapter = self._adapters.get(rid)
292            if adapter and adapter.capabilities.supports_root_lookup:
293                try:
294                    results[rid] = adapter.lookup_by_root(root_form, limit)
295                except Exception:
296                    # Log but continue with other adapters
297                    pass
298        return results
299
300    def lookup_lemma_across_resources(
301        self,
302        lemma_form: str,
303        limit: int = 50,
304        resource_ids: list[str] | None = None,
305    ) -> dict[str, LexicalLookupResult]:
306        """
307        Look up a lemma across multiple resources.
308
309        Args:
310            lemma_form: Arabic lemma
311            limit: Maximum results per resource
312            resource_ids: Specific resources to search (None = all)
313
314        Returns:
315            Dict mapping resource_id to LexicalLookupResult
316        """
317        results = {}
318        targets = resource_ids or list(self._adapters.keys())
319        for rid in targets:
320            adapter = self._adapters.get(rid)
321            if adapter and adapter.capabilities.supports_lemma_lookup:
322                try:
323                    results[rid] = adapter.lookup_by_lemma(lemma_form, limit)
324                except Exception:
325                    pass
326        return results
327
328    def close_all(self) -> None:
329        """Close all registered adapters."""
330        for adapter in self._adapters.values():
331            adapter.close()
332        self._adapters.clear()
333        self._resource_metadata.clear()

class AdapterRegistry: 
 73class AdapterRegistry:
 74    """Registry for managing multiple adapters of the same type."""
 75
 76    def __init__(self):
 77        self._adapters: dict[str, Adapter] = {}
 78
 79    def register(self, adapter: Adapter) -> None:
 80        """Register an adapter."""
 81        adapter_id = adapter.metadata.adapter_id
 82        if adapter_id in self._adapters:
 83            raise ValueError(f"Adapter already registered: {adapter_id}")
 84        self._adapters[adapter_id] = adapter
 85
 86    def unregister(self, adapter_id: str) -> None:
 87        """Unregister an adapter."""
 88        if adapter_id in self._adapters:
 89            del self._adapters[adapter_id]
 90
 91    def get(self, adapter_id: str) -> Adapter | None:
 92        """Get an adapter by ID."""
 93        return self._adapters.get(adapter_id)
 94
 95    def list_adapters(self) -> list[AdapterMetadata]:
 96        """List all registered adapters."""
 97        return [adapter.metadata for adapter in self._adapters.values()]
 98
 99    def load_all(self) -> None:
100        """Load all registered adapters."""
101        for adapter in self._adapters.values():
102            adapter.ensure_loaded()
103
104    def get_first_loaded(self) -> Adapter | None:
105        """Get the first loaded adapter, loading it if necessary."""
106        for adapter in self._adapters.values():
107            adapter.ensure_loaded()
108            return adapter
109        return None

141class TafsirAdapterRegistry(AdapterRegistry):
142    """Registry for tafsir adapters."""
143
144    def register(self, adapter: TafsirAdapter) -> None:
145        if not isinstance(adapter, TafsirAdapter):
146            raise TypeError("Adapter must be a TafsirAdapter")
147        super().register(adapter)
148
149    def get_all_tafsir(
150        self,
151        surah: int,
152        ayah: int,
153    ) -> dict[str, list[TafsirEntry]]:
154        """Get tafsir from all loaded adapters for an ayah."""
155        results = {}
156        for adapter in self._adapters.values():
157            adapter.ensure_loaded()
158            try:
159                entries = adapter.get_tafsir(surah, ayah)
160                if entries:
161                    results[adapter.metadata.adapter_id] = entries
162            except Exception:
163                # Log but continue with other adapters
164                pass
165        return results
166
167    # Proxy methods to first loaded adapter
168    def get_tafsir(
169        self,
170        surah: int,
171        ayah: int,
172        source_id: str | None = None,
173    ) -> list[TafsirEntry]:
174        """Get tafsir from the first loaded adapter."""
175        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
176        if adapter:
177            return adapter.get_tafsir(surah, ayah, source_id)
178        return []
179
180    def get_tafsir_range(
181        self,
182        surah: int,
183        ayah_start: int,
184        ayah_end: int,
185        source_id: str | None = None,
186    ) -> list[TafsirEntry]:
187        """Get tafsir range from the first loaded adapter."""
188        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
189        if adapter:
190            return adapter.get_tafsir_range(surah, ayah_start, ayah_end, source_id)
191        return []
192
193    def list_sources(self) -> list[TafsirSource]:
194        """List sources from the first loaded adapter."""
195        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
196        if adapter:
197            return adapter.list_sources()
198        return []
199
200    def search_tafsir(
201        self,
202        query: str,
203        source_id: str | None = None,
204        limit: int = 50,
205    ) -> list[TafsirSearchResult]:
206        """Search tafsir from the first loaded adapter."""
207        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
208        if adapter:
209            return adapter.search_tafsir(query, source_id, limit)
210        return []
211
212    def get_source(self, source_id: str) -> TafsirSource | None:
213        """Get source from the first loaded adapter."""
214        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
215        if adapter:
216            return adapter.get_source(source_id)
217        return None

148class WaqfAdapterRegistry(AdapterRegistry):
149    """Registry for waqf adapters."""
150
151    def register(self, adapter: WaqfAdapter) -> None:
152        if not isinstance(adapter, WaqfAdapter):
153            raise TypeError("Adapter must be a WaqfAdapter")
154        super().register(adapter)
155
156    # Proxy methods to first loaded adapter
157    def get_waqf_rules(
158        self,
159        waqf_type: WaqfType | None = None,
160    ) -> list[WaqfRule]:
161        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
162        if adapter:
163            return adapter.get_waqf_rules(waqf_type)
164        return []
165
166    def get_ibtida_rules(
167        self,
168        ibtida_type: IbtidaType | None = None,
169    ) -> list[WaqfRule]:
170        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
171        if adapter:
172            return adapter.get_ibtida_rules(ibtida_type)
173        return []
174
175    def get_rule(self, rule_id: str) -> WaqfRule | None:
176        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
177        if adapter:
178            return adapter.get_rule(rule_id)
179        return None
180
181    def get_annotations_for_ayah(
182        self,
183        surah: int,
184        ayah: int,
185    ) -> list[WaqfAnnotation]:
186        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
187        if adapter:
188            return adapter.get_annotations_for_ayah(surah, ayah)
189        return []
190
191    def get_waqf_signs_in_ayah(
192        self,
193        surah: int,

196        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
197        if adapter:
198            return adapter.get_waqf_signs_in_ayah(surah, ayah)
199        return []
200
201    def annotate_text(
202        self,
203        surah: int,
204        ayah: int,
205        base_text: str,
206    ) -> list[WaqfAnnotation]:
207        adapter = self.get_first_loaded()
208        if adapter:
209            return adapter.annotate_text(surah, ayah, base_text)
210        return []

23    WAQF_MUTLAQ = "waqf_mutlaq"  # Absolute stop
24    WAQF_MURAKHAS = "waqf_murakhass"  # Licensed stop
25    SAKTAH = "saktah"  # Brief pause without breath
26    WAQF_MUANNAQ = "waqf_muannaq"  # Embracing stop
27    QIF = "qif"  # Stop sign

class MutashabihatEngine: 
 80class MutashabihatEngine:
 81    """
 82    Engine for finding repeated and similar phrases in the Qur'an.
 83
 84    Supports:
 85    - Exact phrase matching (deterministic)
 86    - Exact n-gram matching (deterministic)
 87    - Normalized exact matching (diacritic-insensitive, etc.)
 88    - Near-duplicate detection (computational suggestion)
 89    - Shared root/lemma analysis (when morphology data available)
 90    - Similar openings/endings (deterministic)
 91    - Recurring expressions (deterministic)
 92    """
 93
 94    def __init__(
 95        self,
 96        data_access: DataAccess | None = None,
 97        default_normalization: str = "diacritics-insensitive-v1",
 98    ):
 99        """
100        Initialize mutashabihat engine.
101
102        Args:
103            data_access: DataAccess instance for database queries
104            default_normalization: Default normalization profile for matches
105        """
106        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
107        self.default_normalization = default_normalization
108        self._ngram_cache: dict[str, dict[tuple[str, ...], list[tuple[int, int]]]] = {}
109
110    def find_exact_phrase(
111        self,
112        reference: str,
113        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
114        min_length: int = 2,
115    ) -> MutashabihatResult:
116        """
117        Find exact phrase matches for a given ayah.
118
119        Args:
120            reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255")
121            edition_id: Text edition to search
122            min_length: Minimum phrase length in words
123
124        Returns:
125            MutashabihatResult with exact phrase matches
126        """
127        # Parse reference
128        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
129
130        # Get the ayah text
131        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
132        if not ayah_text:
133            raise ValueError(f"Ayah not found: {reference}")
134
135        # Tokenize
136        tokens = ayah_text.text_original.split()
137
138        matches = []
139
140        # Search for each possible phrase (subsequence of tokens)
141        for start in range(len(tokens)):
142            for end in range(start + min_length, len(tokens) + 1):
143                phrase = " ".join(tokens[start:end])
144
145                # Search for this exact phrase
146                results = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
147                    """
148                    SELECT edition_id, surah_number, ayah_number, text_original
149                    FROM ayah_text_fts_exact
150                    WHERE edition_id = ? AND text_original LIKE ?
151                    AND NOT (surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?)
152                    """,
153                    (edition_id, f"%{phrase}%", surah_num, ayah_num),
154                )
155
156                for row in results:
157                    left_ref = f"{surah_num}:{ayah_num}"
158                    right_ref = f"{row['surah_number']}:{row['ayah_number']}"
159
160                    # Avoid duplicates (only report left < right)
161                    if (surah_num, ayah_num) < (row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]):
162                        matches.append(
163                            PhraseMatch(
164                                left_reference=left_ref,
165                                right_reference=right_ref,
166                                left_text=ayah_text.text_original,
167                                right_text=row["text_original"],
168                                left_surah=surah_num,
169                                left_ayah=ayah_num,
170                                right_surah=row["surah_number"],
171                                right_ayah=row["ayah_number"],
172                                match_method=MatchMethod.EXACT_PHRASE,
173                                match_category=MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
174                                score=1.0,
175                                alignment={"phrase": phrase, "left_start": start, "left_end": end},
176                            )
177                        )
178
179        return MutashabihatResult(
180            query_reference=reference,
181            query_text=ayah_text.text_original,
182            matches=matches,
183            method=MatchMethod.EXACT_PHRASE,
184            total_matches=len(matches),
185        )
186
187    def find_exact_ngrams(
188        self,
189        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
190        n: int = 3,
191        min_occurrences: int = 2,
192    ) -> list[PhraseMatch]:
193        """
194        Find all exact n-grams that occur at least min_occurrences times.
195
196        Args:
197            edition_id: Text edition to search
198            n: N-gram size (number of words)
199            min_occurrences: Minimum occurrences to report
200
201        Returns:
202            List of PhraseMatch for recurring n-grams
203        """
204        cache_key = f"{edition_id}:{n}"
205        if cache_key not in self._ngram_cache:
206            self._build_ngram_index(edition_id, n)
207
208        ngram_index = self._ngram_cache[cache_key]
209
210        matches = []
211        for ngram, locations in ngram_index.items():
212            if len(locations) >= min_occurrences:
213                # Create pairwise matches
214                for i in range(len(locations)):
215                    for j in range(i + 1, len(locations)):
216                        left_surah, left_ayah = locations[i]
217                        right_surah, right_ayah = locations[j]
218
219                        left_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
220                            edition_id, left_surah, left_ayah
221                        )
222                        right_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
223                            edition_id, right_surah, right_ayah
224                        )
225
226                        if left_text and right_text:
227                            matches.append(
228                                PhraseMatch(
229                                    left_reference=f"{left_surah}:{left_ayah}",
230                                    right_reference=f"{right_surah}:{right_ayah}",
231                                    left_text=left_text.text_original,
232                                    right_text=right_text.text_original,
233                                    left_surah=left_surah,
234                                    left_ayah=left_ayah,
235                                    right_surah=right_surah,
236                                    right_ayah=right_ayah,
237                                    match_method=MatchMethod.EXACT_NGRAM,
238                                    match_category=MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
239                                    score=1.0,
240                                    alignment={"ngram": " ".join(ngram), "n": n},
241                                )
242                            )
243
244        return matches
245
246    def _build_ngram_index(
247        self, edition_id: str, n: int
248    ) -> dict[tuple[str, ...], list[tuple[int, int]]]:
249        """Build an index of n-grams for fast lookup."""
250        index: dict[tuple[str, ...], list[tuple[int, int]]] = defaultdict(list)
251
252        # Get all ayahs
253        ayahs = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
254            """
255            SELECT surah_number, ayah_number, text_original
256            FROM ayah_text
257            WHERE edition_id = ?
258            ORDER BY surah_number, ayah_number
259            """,
260            (edition_id,),
261        )
262
263        for row in ayahs:
264            tokens = row["text_original"].split()
265            if len(tokens) >= n:
266                for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1):
267                    ngram = tuple(tokens[i : i + n])
268                    index[ngram].append((row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]))
269
270        self._ngram_cache[f"{edition_id}:{n}"] = index
271        return index

273    def find_normalized_matches(
274        self,
275        reference: str,
276        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
277        normalization_profile: str = "diacritics-insensitive-v1",
278        min_words: int = 2,
279    ) -> MutashabihatResult:
280        """
281        Find matches using normalized text comparison.
282
283        Args:
284            reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255")
285            edition_id: Text edition to search
286            normalization_profile: Normalization profile to use
287            min_words: Minimum matching word count
288
289        Returns:
290            MutashabihatResult with normalized matches
291        """
292        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
293
294        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
295        if not ayah_text:
296            raise ValueError(f"Ayah not found: {reference}")
297
298        # Normalize query text
299        norm_query = normalize(ayah_text.text_original, normalization_profile)
300
301        # Search using the normalized index
302        table_map = {
303            "diacritics-insensitive-v1": "ayah_text_fts_diacritic_insensitive",
304            "search-broad-v1": "ayah_text_fts_broad",
305            "canonical-unicode-v1": "ayah_text_fts_diacritic_insensitive",
306        }
307
308        table = table_map.get(normalization_profile)
309        if not table:
310            raise ValueError(f"Unknown normalization profile: {normalization_profile}")
311
312        # Get all matching ayahs
313        results = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
314            f"""
315            SELECT edition_id, surah_number, ayah_number, text_normalized
316            FROM {table}
317            WHERE edition_id = ? AND text_normalized LIKE ?
318            AND NOT (surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?)
319            """,
320            (edition_id, f"%{norm_query.normalized}%", surah_num, ayah_num),
321        )
322
323        matches = []
324        for row in results:
325            if (surah_num, ayah_num) < (row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]):
326                # Get original texts
327                left_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
328                right_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
329                    edition_id, row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]
330                )
331
332                if left_text and right_text:
333                    matches.append(
334                        MutashabihatEngine._create_phrase_match({
335                            "left_surah": surah_num,
336                            "left_ayah": ayah_num,
337                            "right_surah": row["surah_number"],
338                            "right_ayah": row["ayah_number"],
339                            "left_text": left_text.text_original,
340                            "right_text": right_text.text_original,
341                            "match_method": MatchMethod.NORMALIZED_EXACT,
342                            "match_category": MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
343                            "normalization_profile": normalization_profile,
344                            "score": 1.0,
345                        })
346                    )
347
348        return MutashabihatResult(
349            query_reference=reference,
350            query_text=ayah_text.text_original,
351            matches=matches,
352            method=MatchMethod.NORMALIZED_EXACT,
353            normalization_profile=normalization_profile,
354            total_matches=len(matches),
355        )
356
357    @staticmethod
358    def _get_fts_table(normalization_profile: str) -> str:
359        """Map normalization profile to FTS table name."""
360        table_map = {
361            "diacritics-insensitive-v1": "ayah_text_fts_diacritic_insensitive",
362            "search-broad-v1": "ayah_text_fts_broad",
363            "canonical-unicode-v1": "ayah_text_fts_diacritic_insensitive",
364        }
365        return table_map.get(normalization_profile, "ayah_text_fts_broad")
366
367    def _get_normalized_tokens(
368        self, edition_id: str, surah_num: int, ayah_num: int, profile: str
369    ) -> set[str] | None:
370        """Get normalized tokens for an ayah."""
371        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
372        if not ayah_text:
373            return None
374        norm = normalize(ayah_text.text_original, profile)
375        return set(norm.normalized.split())
376
377    @staticmethod
378    def _jaccard_similarity(tokens_a: set[str], tokens_b: set[str]) -> float:
379        """Calculate Jaccard similarity between two token sets."""
380        intersection = len(tokens_a & tokens_b)
381        union = len(tokens_a | tokens_b)
382        return intersection / union if union > 0 else 0.0
383
384    @staticmethod
385    def _create_phrase_match(params: dict[str, Any]) -> PhraseMatch:
386        """Create a PhraseMatch object from a parameter dict."""
387        return PhraseMatch(
388            left_reference=f"{params['left_surah']}:{params['left_ayah']}",
389            right_reference=f"{params['right_surah']}:{params['right_ayah']}",
390            left_text=params["left_text"],
391            right_text=params["right_text"],
392            left_surah=params["left_surah"],
393            left_ayah=params["left_ayah"],
394            right_surah=params["right_surah"],
395            right_ayah=params["right_ayah"],
396            match_method=params["match_method"],
397            match_category=params["match_category"],
398            normalization_profile=params.get("normalization_profile"),
399            score=params.get("score"),
400            alignment=params.get("alignment"),
401        )
402
403    def find_near_duplicates(
404        self,
405        reference: str,
406        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
407        threshold: float = 0.7,
408        normalization_profile: str = "search-broad-v1",
409    ) -> MutashabihatResult:
410        """
411        Find near-duplicate phrases using token-based similarity.
412
413        Args:
414            reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255")
415            edition_id: Text edition to search
416            threshold: Minimum Jaccard similarity (0.0-1.0)
417            normalization_profile: Normalization profile for comparison
418
419        Returns:
420            MutashabihatResult with near-duplicate matches
421        """
422        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
423
424        query_tokens = self._get_normalized_tokens(
425            edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num, normalization_profile
426        )
427        if query_tokens is None:
428            raise ValueError(f"Ayah not found: {reference}")
429
430        table = self._get_fts_table(normalization_profile)
431
432        results = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
433            f"""
434            SELECT edition_id, surah_number, ayah_number, text_normalized
435            FROM {table}
436            WHERE edition_id = ?
437            AND NOT (surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?)
438            """,
439            (edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num),
440        )
441
442        matches = []
443        for row in results:
444            candidate_tokens = set(row["text_normalized"].split())
445            jaccard = self._jaccard_similarity(query_tokens, candidate_tokens)
446
447            if jaccard >= threshold:
448                right_surah, right_ayah = row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]
449                if (surah_num, ayah_num) < (right_surah, right_ayah):
450                    left_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
451                        edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num
452                    ).text_original
453                    right_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
454                        edition_id, right_surah, right_ayah
455                    ).text_original
456
457                    matches.append(
458                        MutashabihatEngine._create_phrase_match({
459                            "left_surah": surah_num,
460                            "left_ayah": ayah_num,
461                            "right_surah": right_surah,
462                            "right_ayah": right_ayah,
463                            "left_text": left_text,
464                            "right_text": right_text,
465                            "match_method": MatchMethod.NEAR_DUPLICATE,
466                            "match_category": MatchCategory.COMPUTATIONAL_SUGGESTION,
467                            "normalization_profile": normalization_profile,
468                            "score": jaccard,
469                            "alignment": {
470                                "jaccard": jaccard,
471                                "common_tokens": list(query_tokens & candidate_tokens),
472                                "query_only": list(query_tokens - candidate_tokens),
473                                "candidate_only": list(candidate_tokens - query_tokens),
474                            },
475                        })
476                    )
477
478        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
479        return MutashabihatResult(
480            query_reference=reference,
481            query_text=ayah_text.text_original,
482            matches=matches,
483            method=MatchMethod.NEAR_DUPLICATE,
484            normalization_profile=normalization_profile,
485            total_matches=len(matches),
486            parameters={"threshold": threshold},
487        )

668                        right_surah, right_ayah, right_text = locations[j]

Engine for finding repeated and similar phrases in the Qur'an.

Supports:

  • Exact phrase matching (deterministic)
  • Exact n-gram matching (deterministic)
  • Normalized exact matching (diacritic-insensitive, etc.)
  • Near-duplicate detection (computational suggestion)
  • Shared root/lemma analysis (when morphology data available)
  • Similar openings/endings (deterministic)
  • Recurring expressions (deterministic)

110    def find_exact_phrase(
111        self,
112        reference: str,
113        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
114        min_length: int = 2,
115    ) -> MutashabihatResult:
116        """
117        Find exact phrase matches for a given ayah.
118
119        Args:
120            reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255")
121            edition_id: Text edition to search
122            min_length: Minimum phrase length in words
123
124        Returns:

126        """
127        # Parse reference
128        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
129
130        # Get the ayah text
131        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
132        if not ayah_text:
133            raise ValueError(f"Ayah not found: {reference}")
134
135        # Tokenize
136        tokens = ayah_text.text_original.split()
137
138        matches = []
139
140        # Search for each possible phrase (subsequence of tokens)
141        for start in range(len(tokens)):
142            for end in range(start + min_length, len(tokens) + 1):
143                phrase = " ".join(tokens[start:end])
144
145                # Search for this exact phrase
146                results = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
147                    """
148                    SELECT edition_id, surah_number, ayah_number, text_original
149                    FROM ayah_text_fts_exact
150                    WHERE edition_id = ? AND text_original LIKE ?
151                    AND NOT (surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?)
152                    """,
153                    (edition_id, f"%{phrase}%", surah_num, ayah_num),
154                )
155
156                for row in results:
157                    left_ref = f"{surah_num}:{ayah_num}"
158                    right_ref = f"{row['surah_number']}:{row['ayah_number']}"
159
160                    # Avoid duplicates (only report left < right)
161                    if (surah_num, ayah_num) < (row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]):
162                        matches.append(
163                            PhraseMatch(
164                                left_reference=left_ref,
165                                right_reference=right_ref,
166                                left_text=ayah_text.text_original,
167                                right_text=row["text_original"],
168                                left_surah=surah_num,

171                                right_ayah=row["ayah_number"],
172                                match_method=MatchMethod.EXACT_PHRASE,
173                                match_category=MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
174                                score=1.0,
175                                alignment={"phrase": phrase, "left_start": start, "left_end": end},
176                            )
177                        )
178
179        return MutashabihatResult(
180            query_reference=reference,
181            query_text=ayah_text.text_original,

def find_exact_ngrams( self, edition_id: str = 'tanzil-uthmani-v1', n: int = 3, min_occurrences: int = 2) -> list[PhraseMatch]: 
187    def find_exact_ngrams(
188        self,
189        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
190        n: int = 3,
191        min_occurrences: int = 2,
192    ) -> list[PhraseMatch]:
193        """
194        Find all exact n-grams that occur at least min_occurrences times.
195
196        Args:
197            edition_id: Text edition to search
198            n: N-gram size (number of words)
199            min_occurrences: Minimum occurrences to report
200
201        Returns:
202            List of PhraseMatch for recurring n-grams
203        """
204        cache_key = f"{edition_id}:{n}"
205        if cache_key not in self._ngram_cache:
206            self._build_ngram_index(edition_id, n)
207
208        ngram_index = self._ngram_cache[cache_key]
209
210        matches = []
211        for ngram, locations in ngram_index.items():
212            if len(locations) >= min_occurrences:
213                # Create pairwise matches
214                for i in range(len(locations)):
215                    for j in range(i + 1, len(locations)):
216                        left_surah, left_ayah = locations[i]
217                        right_surah, right_ayah = locations[j]
218
219                        left_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
220                            edition_id, left_surah, left_ayah
221                        )
222                        right_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
223                            edition_id, right_surah, right_ayah
224                        )
225
226                        if left_text and right_text:
227                            matches.append(
228                                PhraseMatch(
229                                    left_reference=f"{left_surah}:{left_ayah}",
230                                    right_reference=f"{right_surah}:{right_ayah}",
231                                    left_text=left_text.text_original,
232                                    right_text=right_text.text_original,
233                                    left_surah=left_surah,
234                                    left_ayah=left_ayah,
235                                    right_surah=right_surah,
236                                    right_ayah=right_ayah,
237                                    match_method=MatchMethod.EXACT_NGRAM,
238                                    match_category=MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
239                                    score=1.0,
240                                    alignment={"ngram": " ".join(ngram), "n": n},
241                                )
242                            )
243
244        return matches

def find_normalized_matches( self, reference: str, edition_id: str = 'tanzil-uthmani-v1', normalization_profile: str = 'diacritics-insensitive-v1', min_words: int = 2) -> MutashabihatResult: 
273    def find_normalized_matches(
274        self,
275        reference: str,
276        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
277        normalization_profile: str = "diacritics-insensitive-v1",
278        min_words: int = 2,
279    ) -> MutashabihatResult:
280        """
281        Find matches using normalized text comparison.
282
283        Args:
284            reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255")
285            edition_id: Text edition to search
286            normalization_profile: Normalization profile to use
287            min_words: Minimum matching word count
288
289        Returns:
290            MutashabihatResult with normalized matches
291        """
292        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
293
294        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
295        if not ayah_text:
296            raise ValueError(f"Ayah not found: {reference}")
297
298        # Normalize query text
299        norm_query = normalize(ayah_text.text_original, normalization_profile)
300
301        # Search using the normalized index
302        table_map = {
303            "diacritics-insensitive-v1": "ayah_text_fts_diacritic_insensitive",
304            "search-broad-v1": "ayah_text_fts_broad",
305            "canonical-unicode-v1": "ayah_text_fts_diacritic_insensitive",
306        }
307
308        table = table_map.get(normalization_profile)
309        if not table:
310            raise ValueError(f"Unknown normalization profile: {normalization_profile}")
311
312        # Get all matching ayahs
313        results = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
314            f"""
315            SELECT edition_id, surah_number, ayah_number, text_normalized
316            FROM {table}
317            WHERE edition_id = ? AND text_normalized LIKE ?
318            AND NOT (surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?)
319            """,
320            (edition_id, f"%{norm_query.normalized}%", surah_num, ayah_num),
321        )
322
323        matches = []
324        for row in results:
325            if (surah_num, ayah_num) < (row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]):
326                # Get original texts
327                left_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
328                right_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
329                    edition_id, row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]
330                )
331
332                if left_text and right_text:
333                    matches.append(
334                        MutashabihatEngine._create_phrase_match({
335                            "left_surah": surah_num,
336                            "left_ayah": ayah_num,
337                            "right_surah": row["surah_number"],
338                            "right_ayah": row["ayah_number"],
339                            "left_text": left_text.text_original,
340                            "right_text": right_text.text_original,
341                            "match_method": MatchMethod.NORMALIZED_EXACT,
342                            "match_category": MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
343                            "normalization_profile": normalization_profile,
344                            "score": 1.0,
345                        })
346                    )
347
348        return MutashabihatResult(
349            query_reference=reference,
350            query_text=ayah_text.text_original,
351            matches=matches,
352            method=MatchMethod.NORMALIZED_EXACT,
353            normalization_profile=normalization_profile,
354            total_matches=len(matches),
355        )

Find matches using normalized text comparison.

Args: reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255") edition_id: Text edition to search normalization_profile: Normalization profile to use min_words: Minimum matching word count

def find_near_duplicates( self, reference: str, edition_id: str = 'tanzil-uthmani-v1', threshold: float = 0.7, normalization_profile: str = 'search-broad-v1') -> MutashabihatResult: 
403    def find_near_duplicates(
404        self,
405        reference: str,
406        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
407        threshold: float = 0.7,
408        normalization_profile: str = "search-broad-v1",
409    ) -> MutashabihatResult:
410        """
411        Find near-duplicate phrases using token-based similarity.
412
413        Args:
414            reference: Ayah reference (e.g., "2:255")
415            edition_id: Text edition to search
416            threshold: Minimum Jaccard similarity (0.0-1.0)
417            normalization_profile: Normalization profile for comparison
418
419        Returns:
420            MutashabihatResult with near-duplicate matches
421        """
422        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
423
424        query_tokens = self._get_normalized_tokens(
425            edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num, normalization_profile
426        )
427        if query_tokens is None:
428            raise ValueError(f"Ayah not found: {reference}")
429
430        table = self._get_fts_table(normalization_profile)
431
432        results = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
433            f"""
434            SELECT edition_id, surah_number, ayah_number, text_normalized
435            FROM {table}
436            WHERE edition_id = ?
437            AND NOT (surah_number = ? AND ayah_number = ?)
438            """,
439            (edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num),
440        )
441
442        matches = []
443        for row in results:
444            candidate_tokens = set(row["text_normalized"].split())
445            jaccard = self._jaccard_similarity(query_tokens, candidate_tokens)
446
447            if jaccard >= threshold:
448                right_surah, right_ayah = row["surah_number"], row["ayah_number"]
449                if (surah_num, ayah_num) < (right_surah, right_ayah):
450                    left_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
451                        edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num
452                    ).text_original
453                    right_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(
454                        edition_id, right_surah, right_ayah
455                    ).text_original
456
457                    matches.append(
458                        MutashabihatEngine._create_phrase_match({
459                            "left_surah": surah_num,
460                            "left_ayah": ayah_num,
461                            "right_surah": right_surah,
462                            "right_ayah": right_ayah,
463                            "left_text": left_text,
464                            "right_text": right_text,
465                            "match_method": MatchMethod.NEAR_DUPLICATE,
466                            "match_category": MatchCategory.COMPUTATIONAL_SUGGESTION,
467                            "normalization_profile": normalization_profile,
468                            "score": jaccard,
469                            "alignment": {
470                                "jaccard": jaccard,
471                                "common_tokens": list(query_tokens & candidate_tokens),
472                                "query_only": list(query_tokens - candidate_tokens),
473                                "candidate_only": list(candidate_tokens - query_tokens),
474                            },
475                        })
476                    )
477
478        ayah_text = self.data_access.get_ayah_text(edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num)
479        return MutashabihatResult(
480            query_reference=reference,
481            query_text=ayah_text.text_original,
482            matches=matches,
483            method=MatchMethod.NEAR_DUPLICATE,
484            normalization_profile=normalization_profile,
485            total_matches=len(matches),
486            parameters={"threshold": threshold},
487        )

489    def find_similar_openings(
490        self,
491        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
492        prefix_length: int = 3,
493        min_occurrences: int = 2,
494    ) -> list[PhraseMatch]:
495        """
496        Find ayahs with similar opening phrases.
497
498        Args:
499            edition_id: Text edition to search
500            prefix_length: Number of words to compare at start
501            min_occurrences: Minimum occurrences to report
502
503        Returns:
504            List of PhraseMatch for similar openings
505        """
506        ayahs = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
507            """
508            SELECT surah_number, ayah_number, text_original
509            FROM ayah_text
510            WHERE edition_id = ?
511            ORDER BY surah_number, ayah_number
512            """,
513            (edition_id,),
514        )
515
516        prefix_index: dict[tuple[str, ...], list[tuple[int, int, str]]] = defaultdict(list)
517
518        for row in ayahs:
519            tokens = row["text_original"].split()

528        matches = []

532                    for j in range(i + 1, len(locations)):
533                        left_surah, left_ayah, left_text = locations[i]
534                        right_surah, right_ayah, right_text = locations[j]
535
536                        matches.append(
537                            PhraseMatch(
538                                left_reference=f"{left_surah}:{left_ayah}",
539                                right_reference=f"{right_surah}:{right_ayah}",
540                                left_text=left_text,
541                                right_text=right_text,
542                                left_surah=left_surah,
543                                left_ayah=left_ayah,

546                                match_method=MatchMethod.SIMILAR_OPENING,
547                                match_category=MatchCategory.DETERMINISTIC_RESULT,
548                                score=1.0,
549                                alignment={"prefix": " ".join(prefix), "length": prefix_length},
550                            )
551                        )
552
553        return matches

 49class ReportGenerator:
 50    """Generate comparison reports from mutashabihat results."""
 51
 52    def __init__(self, data_access: DataAccess | None = None):
 53        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
 54
 55    def generate_report(
 56        self,
 57        result: MutashabihatResult,
 58        edition_id: str,
 59        query_reference: str,
 60    ) -> ComparisonReport:
 61        """Generate a structured report from mutashabihat results."""
 62        if not result.matches:
 63            return ComparisonReport(
 64                query_reference=query_reference,
 65                query_text=result.query_text,
 66                edition_id=edition_id,
 67                method=result.method,
 68                normalization_profile=result.normalization_profile,
 69                total_matches=0,
 70            )
 71
 72        # Collect statistics
 73        matches_by_category: dict[str, int] = {}
 74        matches_by_method: dict[str, int] = {}
 75        scores: list[float] = []
 76        surahs: set[int] = set()
 77        ayahs: set[int] = set()
 78
 79        for m in result.matches:
 80            # Count by category
 81            cat = m.match_category.value
 82            matches_by_category[cat] = matches_by_category.get(cat, 0) + 1
 83
 84            # Count by method
 85            meth = m.match_method.value
 86            matches_by_method[meth] = matches_by_method.get(meth, 0) + 1
 87
 88            # Collect scores
 89            if m.score is not None:
 90                scores.append(m.score)
 91
 92            # Collect unique surahs/ayahs
 93            surahs.add(m.right_surah)
 94            ayahs.add(m.right_ayah)
 95
 96        # Score statistics
 97        score_stats = {}
 98        if scores:
 99            score_stats = {
100                "min": min(scores),
101                "max": max(scores),
102                "mean": sum(scores) / len(scores),
103                "count": len(scores),
104            }
105
106        return ComparisonReport(
107            query_reference=query_reference,
108            query_text=result.query_text,
109            edition_id=edition_id,
110            method=result.method,
111            normalization_profile=result.normalization_profile,
112            total_matches=result.total_matches,
113            matches_by_category=matches_by_category,
114            matches_by_method=matches_by_method,
115            unique_surahs_matched=sorted(surahs),
116            unique_ayahs_matched=sorted(ayahs),
117            score_stats=score_stats,
118            parameters=result.parameters,
119        )
120
121    def generate_multi_report(
122        self,
123        references: list[str],
124        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
125        method: MatchMethod = MatchMethod.EXACT_PHRASE,
126        **kwargs,
127    ) -> list[ComparisonReport]:
128        """Generate reports for multiple references."""
129        from qurankit.analysis import MutashabihatEngine
130
131        engine = MutashabihatEngine(self.data_access)
132        reports = []
133
134        for ref in references:
135            if method == MatchMethod.EXACT_PHRASE:
136                result = engine.find_exact_phrase(ref, edition_id=edition_id, **kwargs)
137            elif method == MatchMethod.NORMALIZED_EXACT:
138                result = engine.find_normalized_matches(ref, edition_id=edition_id, **kwargs)
139            elif method == MatchMethod.NEAR_DUPLICATE:
140                result = engine.find_near_duplicates(ref, edition_id=edition_id, **kwargs)
141            else:
142                continue
143
144            report = self.generate_report(result, edition_id, ref)
145            reports.append(report)
146
147        return reports
148
149    def generate_corpus_statistics(
150        self,
151        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
152    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
153        """Generate corpus-level statistics for mutashabihat analysis."""
154        # Get all ayahs
155        ayahs = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
156            """
157            SELECT surah_number, ayah_number, text_original
158            FROM ayah_text
159            WHERE edition_id = ?
160            ORDER BY surah_number, ayah_number
161            """,
162            (edition_id,),
163        )
164
165        if not ayahs:
166            return {"error": "No data found for edition"}
167
168        # Count recurring phrases (min 2 words, min 2 occurrences)
169        from qurankit.analysis import MutashabihatEngine
170        engine = MutashabihatEngine(self.data_access)
171
172        # Find all n-grams
173        ngram_stats = {}
174        for n in [2, 3, 4]:
175            matches = engine.find_exact_ngrams(edition_id=edition_id, n=n, min_occurrences=2)
176            unique_ngrams = set()
177            for m in matches:
178                ngram = m.alignment.get("ngram", "") if m.alignment else ""
179                if ngram:
180                    unique_ngrams.add(ngram)
181            ngram_stats[f"{n}_gram"] = {
182                "total_matches": len(matches),
183                "unique_ngrams": len(unique_ngrams),
184            }
185
186        # Similar openings/endings
187        openings = engine.find_similar_openings(edition_id=edition_id, prefix_length=3, min_occurrences=2)
188        endings = engine.find_similar_endings(edition_id=edition_id, suffix_length=3, min_occurrences=2)
189
190        opening_ngrams = set()
191        for m in openings:
192            ngram = m.alignment.get("prefix", "") if m.alignment else ""
193            if ngram:
194                opening_ngrams.add(ngram)
195
196        ending_ngrams = set()
197        for m in endings:
198            ngram = m.alignment.get("suffix", "") if m.alignment else ""
199            if ngram:
200                ending_ngrams.add(ngram)
201
202        return {
203            "edition_id": edition_id,
204            "total_ayahs": len(ayahs),
205            "total_surahs": max(a["surah_number"] for a in ayahs) if ayahs else 0,
206            "ngram_statistics": ngram_stats,
207            "similar_openings": {
208                "total_pairs": len(openings),
209                "unique_patterns": len(opening_ngrams),
210            },
211            "similar_endings": {
212                "total_pairs": len(endings),
213                "unique_patterns": len(ending_ngrams),
214            },
215        }
216
217    def format_report_text(self, report: ComparisonReport) -> str:
218        """Format report as human-readable text."""
219        lines = [
220            "=== Mutashabihat Comparison Report ===",
221            f"Query: {report.query_reference}",
222            f"Edition: {report.edition_id}",
223            f"Method: {report.method.value}",
224            f"Normalization: {report.normalization_profile or 'N/A'}",
225            "",
226            f"Total Matches: {report.total_matches}",
227            "",
228            "--- By Category ---",
229        ]
230        for cat, count in sorted(report.matches_by_category.items()):
231            lines.append(f"  {cat}: {count}")
232
233        lines.append("")
234        lines.append("--- By Method ---")
235        for meth, count in sorted(report.matches_by_method.items()):
236            lines.append(f"  {meth}: {count}")
237
238        if report.score_stats:
239            lines.append("")
240            lines.append("--- Score Statistics ---")
241            lines.append(f"  Min: {report.score_stats.get('min', 0):.3f}")
242            lines.append(f"  Max: {report.score_stats.get('max', 0):.3f}")
243            lines.append(f"  Mean: {report.score_stats.get('mean', 0):.3f}")
244
245        lines.append("")
246        lines.append("--- Coverage ---")
247        lines.append(f"  Unique Surahs: {len(report.unique_surahs_matched)}")
248        lines.append(f"  Unique Ayahs: {len(report.unique_ayahs_matched)}")
249
250        if report.parameters:
251            lines.append("")
252            lines.append("--- Parameters ---")
253            for k, v in report.parameters.items():
254                lines.append(f"  {k}: {v}")
255
256        return "\n".join(lines)

116class SemanticRelationExtractor:
117    """Extracts semantic relations from dictionary sources."""
118
119    def __init__(self, registry: DictionaryAdapterRegistry | None = None):
120        self.registry = registry or get_lexicon_registry()
121
122    def _process_lookup_results(
123        self,
124        results: dict[str, Any],
125        relation_types: list[SemanticRelationType] | None,
126    ) -> list[SemanticRelationResult]:
127        """Process lookup results to extract semantic relations."""
128        relations = []
129
130        for resource_id, lookup_result in results.items():
131            adapter = self.registry.get_adapter(resource_id)
132            if not adapter or not adapter.capabilities.supports_semantic_relations:
133                continue
134
135            for entry in lookup_result.entries:
136                try:
137                    entry_relations = adapter.get_semantic_relations(entry.lexical_entry_id)
138                    for rel in entry_relations:
139                        rel_type_str = rel.get("relation_type", "related")
140                        try:
141                            rel_type = SemanticRelationType(rel_type_str)
142                        except ValueError:
143                            rel_type = SemanticRelationType.RELATED
144
145                        if relation_types and rel_type not in relation_types:
146                            continue
147
148                        relations.append(SemanticRelationResult(
149                            subject_entry_id=entry.lexical_entry_id,
150                            subject_headword=entry.headword_original,
151                            subject_root=entry.root_form,
152                            relation_type=rel_type,
153                            object_entry_id=rel.get("target_id", ""),
154                            object_headword=rel.get("target_headword", ""),
155                            object_root=rel.get("target_root"),
156                            evidence=rel.get("evidence"),
157                            confidence=rel.get("confidence"),
158                            source_resource=resource_id,
159                            claim_category=ClaimCategory.SOURCE_ANNOTATION,
160                        ))
161                except Exception:
162                    pass
163
164        return relations
165
166    def find_relations_for_root(
167        self,
168        root_form: str,
169        relation_types: list[SemanticRelationType] | None = None,
170        resource_ids: list[str] | None = None,
171    ) -> list[SemanticRelationResult]:
172        """Find semantic relations for all entries sharing a root."""
173        results = self.registry.lookup_root_across_resources(
174            root_form, limit=100, resource_ids=resource_ids
175        )
176        return self._process_lookup_results(results, relation_types)
177
178    def find_relations_for_lemma(
179        self,
180        lemma_form: str,
181        relation_types: list[SemanticRelationType] | None = None,
182        resource_ids: list[str] | None = None,
183    ) -> list[SemanticRelationResult]:
184        """Find semantic relations for entries matching a lemma."""
185        results = self.registry.lookup_lemma_across_resources(
186            lemma_form, limit=100, resource_ids=resource_ids
187        )
188        return self._process_lookup_results(results, relation_types)
189
190    def find_synonyms(
191        self,
192        root_form: str | None = None,
193        lemma_form: str | None = None,
194        resource_ids: list[str] | None = None,
195    ) -> list[SemanticRelationResult]:
196        """Find synonyms for a root or lemma."""
197        types = [SemanticRelationType.SYNONYM]
198        if root_form:
199            return self.find_relations_for_root(root_form, types, resource_ids)
200        if lemma_form:
201            return self.find_relations_for_lemma(lemma_form, types, resource_ids)
202        return []
203
204    def find_antonyms(
205        self,
206        root_form: str | None = None,
207        lemma_form: str | None = None,
208        resource_ids: list[str] | None = None,
209    ) -> list[SemanticRelationResult]:
210        """Find antonyms for a root or lemma."""
211        types = [SemanticRelationType.ANTONYM]
212        if root_form:
213            return self.find_relations_for_root(root_form, types, resource_ids)
214        if lemma_form:
215            return self.find_relations_for_lemma(lemma_form, types, resource_ids)
216        return []

188        return self._process_lookup_results(results, relation_types)
