219class CollocationAnalyzer:
220    """Computes word co-occurrence and collocation statistics."""
221
222    def __init__(
223        self,
224        vocabulary: QuranicVocabulary | None = None,
225        data_access: DataAccess | None = None,
226        edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
227    ):
228        self.vocabulary = vocabulary
229        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
230        self.edition_id = edition_id
231
232    def _get_all_ayah_tokens(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
233        """Get all tokens with surah, ayah, position, and root/lemma."""
234        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
235            """
236            SELECT
237                wt.token_id,
238                wt.surah_number,
239                wt.ayah_number,
240                wt.token_index,
241                wt.surface_original,
242                ta.root_id,
243                ta.lemma_id
244            FROM word_token wt
245            LEFT JOIN token_analysis ta ON ta.token_id = wt.token_id
246                AND ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
247            WHERE wt.edition_id = ?
248            ORDER BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number, wt.token_index
249            """,
250            (self.edition_id,),
251        )
252        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
253
254    def compute_collocations(
255        self,
256        window_size: int = 5,
257        min_cooccurrence: int = 3,
258        measure: CooccurrenceMeasure = CooccurrenceMeasure.PMI,
259        top_n: int = 100,
260        filter_stopwords: bool = True,
261    ) -> list[CollocationResult]:
262        """Compute statistically significant collocations."""
263        tokens = self._get_all_ayah_tokens()
264        if not tokens:
265            return []
266
267        token_data = []
268        for t in tokens:
269            root = t["root_id"]
270            root_form = root.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") if root else None
271            token_data.append({
272                "surah": t["surah_number"],
273                "ayah": t["ayah_number"],
274                "index": t["token_index"],
275                "surface": t["surface_original"],
276                "root": root_form,
277            })
278
279        word_counts = Counter()
280        for td in token_data:
281            word_counts[td["surface"]] += 1
282
283        cooccur_counts = Counter()
284        total_windows = 0
285
286        ayah_groups: dict[tuple[int, int], list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
287        for td in token_data:
288            ayah_groups[(td["surah"], td["ayah"])].append(td)
289
290        for ayah_tokens in ayah_groups.values():
291            n = len(ayah_tokens)
292            for i in range(n):
293                w1 = ayah_tokens[i]
294                start = max(0, i - window_size)
295                end = min(n, i + window_size + 1)
296                for j in range(start, end):
297                    if i == j:
298                        continue
299                    w2 = ayah_tokens[j]
300                    pair = tuple(sorted([w1["surface"], w2["surface"]]))
301                    cooccur_counts[pair] += 1
302                total_windows += 1
303
304        stopwords = {
305            "و", "ف", "ب", "ل", "ك", "في", "من", "على", "إلى", "عن", "مع", "هذا", "ذلك",
306            "الذي", "التي", "الذين", "اللذين", "ما", "إن", "أن", "لكن", "إذا",
307            "إذ", "قد", "لا", "لم", "لن", "ليس", "كان", "يكون", "كانوا", "يكونوا"
308        } if filter_stopwords else set()
309
310        results = []
311        total_tokens = len(token_data)
312
313        for (w1, w2), cooc_count in cooccur_counts.items():
314            if cooc_count < min_cooccurrence:
315                continue
316            if w1 in stopwords or w2 in stopwords:
317                continue
318
319            count1 = word_counts.get(w1, 0)
320            count2 = word_counts.get(w2, 0)
321            if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
322                continue
323
324            root1 = None
325            root2 = None
326            for td in token_data:
327                if td["surface"] == w1 and td["root"]:
328                    root1 = td["root"]
329                    break
330            for td in token_data:
331                if td["surface"] == w2 and td["root"]:
332                    root2 = td["root"]
333                    break
334
335            score = 0.0
336
337            if measure == CooccurrenceMeasure.PMI:
338                p_w1w2 = cooc_count / total_windows
339                p_w1 = count1 / total_tokens
340                p_w2 = count2 / total_tokens
341                if p_w1 > 0 and p_w2 > 0:
342                    score = log(p_w1w2 / (p_w1 * p_w2), 2)
343
344            elif measure == CooccurrenceMeasure.DICE:
345                score = (2 * cooc_count) / (count1 + count2)
346
347            elif measure == CooccurrenceMeasure.FREQUENCY:
348                score = float(cooc_count)
349
350            elif measure == CooccurrenceMeasure.LOG_LIKELIHOOD:
351                expected = (count1 * count2) / total_tokens
352                if expected > 0:
353                    score = 2 * (cooc_count * log(cooc_count / expected))
354
355            results.append(CollocationResult(
356                word1=w1,
357                word2=w2,
358                word1_root=root1,
359                word2_root=root2,
360                cooccurrence_count=cooc_count,
361                word1_count=count1,
362                word2_count=count2,
363                total_windows=total_windows,
364                measure=measure,
365                score=score,
366                window_size=window_size,
367            ))
368
369        results.sort(key=lambda x: x.score, reverse=True)
370        return results[:top_n]
371
372    def get_collocations_for_word(
373        self,
374        word: str,
375        window_size: int = 5,
376        measure: CooccurrenceMeasure = CooccurrenceMeasure.PMI,
377        top_n: int = 20,
378    ) -> list[CollocationResult]:
379        """Get collocations for a specific word."""
380        all_collocations = self.compute_collocations(
381            window_size=window_size,
382            measure=measure,
383            top_n=1000,
384        )
385        filtered = [c for c in all_collocations if word in {c.word1, c.word2}]
386        return filtered[:top_n]

Computes word co-occurrence and collocation statistics.

389class CrossReferenceAnalyzer:
390    """Analyzes cross-references between ayahs."""
391
392    def __init__(self, data_access: DataAccess | None = None, edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1"):
393        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
394        self.edition_id = edition_id
395
396    def get_explicit_cross_references(
397        self,
398        reference: str,
399        dataset_id: str | None = None,
400    ) -> list[CrossReference]:
401        """Get explicitly annotated cross-references for an ayah."""
402        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
403
404        query = """
405            SELECT
406                target_surah,
407                target_ayah,
408                relation_type,
409                evidence_note,
410                dataset_id,
411                confidence
412            FROM ayah_cross_reference
413            WHERE source_surah = ? AND source_ayah = ?
414        """
415        params = [surah_num, ayah_num]
416
417        if dataset_id:
418            query += " AND dataset_id = ?"
419            params.append(dataset_id)
420
421        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall(query, params)
422
423        results = []
424        for row in rows:
425            results.append(CrossReference(
426                source_reference=reference,
427                target_reference=f"{row['target_surah']}:{row['target_ayah']}",
428                relation_type=row["relation_type"],
429                evidence=row["evidence_note"],
430                source_dataset=row["dataset_id"],
431                confidence=row["confidence"],
432                claim_category=ClaimCategory.SOURCE_ANNOTATION,
433            ))
434
435        return results
436
437    def find_implicit_links(
438        self,
439        reference: str,
440        min_shared_roots: int = 2,
441        min_shared_lemmas: int = 1,
442        limit: int = 20,
443    ) -> list[CrossReference]:
444        """Find ayahs implicitly linked by shared vocabulary."""
445        surah_num, ayah_num = map(int, reference.split(":"))
446
447        source_tokens = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
448            """
449            SELECT ta.root_id, ta.lemma_id
450            FROM word_token wt
451            JOIN token_analysis ta ON ta.token_id = wt.token_id
452            WHERE wt.edition_id = ? AND wt.surah_number = ? AND wt.ayah_number = ?
453              AND ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
454            """,
455            (self.edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num),
456        )
457
458        source_roots = {r["root_id"] for r in source_tokens if r["root_id"]}
459        source_lemmas = {r["lemma_id"] for r in source_tokens if r["lemma_id"]}
460
461        if not source_roots and not source_lemmas:
462            return []
463
464        root_placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(source_roots))
465        lemma_placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(source_lemmas))
466
467        query = f"""
468            SELECT
469                wt.surah_number,
470                wt.ayah_number,
471                COUNT(DISTINCT ta.root_id) as shared_roots,
472                COUNT(DISTINCT ta.lemma_id) as shared_lemmas,
473                GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ta.root_id) as roots_list,
474                GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ta.lemma_id) as lemmas_list
475            FROM word_token wt
476            JOIN token_analysis ta ON ta.token_id = wt.token_id
477            WHERE wt.edition_id = ?
478              AND ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
479              AND (ta.root_id IN ({root_placeholders}) OR ta.lemma_id IN ({lemma_placeholders}))
480              AND NOT (wt.surah_number = ? AND wt.ayah_number = ?)
481            GROUP BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number
482            HAVING shared_roots >= ? OR shared_lemmas >= ?
483            ORDER BY shared_roots DESC, shared_lemmas DESC
484            LIMIT ?
485        """
486
487        params = (
488            [self.edition_id]
489            + list(source_roots)
490            + list(source_lemmas)
491            + [surah_num, ayah_num, min_shared_roots, min_shared_lemmas, limit]
492        )
493
494        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall(query, params)
495
496        results = []
497        for row in rows:
498            roots_list = row["roots_list"].split(",") if row["roots_list"] else []
499            lemmas_list = row["lemmas_list"].split(",") if row["lemmas_list"] else []
500
501            root_forms = [r.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") for r in roots_list]
502            lemma_forms = [lm.replace("qac-lemma:", "") for lm in lemmas_list]
503
504            results.append(CrossReference(
505                source_reference=reference,
506                target_reference=f"{row['surah_number']}:{row['ayah_number']}",
507                relation_type="lexical_overlap",
508                evidence=f"Shared roots: {', '.join(root_forms)}; Shared lemmas: {', '.join(lemma_forms)}",
509                source_dataset="computed",
510                confidence=min(1.0, (row["shared_roots"] + row["shared_lemmas"]) / 10.0),
511                claim_category=ClaimCategory.COMPUTATIONAL_SUGGESTION,
512            ))
513
514        return results

450            FROM word_token wt
451            JOIN token_analysis ta ON ta.token_id = wt.token_id
452            WHERE wt.edition_id = ? AND wt.surah_number = ? AND wt.ayah_number = ?
453              AND ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
454            """,
455            (self.edition_id, surah_num, ayah_num),
456        )
457
458        source_roots = {r["root_id"] for r in source_tokens if r["root_id"]}
459        source_lemmas = {r["lemma_id"] for r in source_tokens if r["lemma_id"]}
460
461        if not source_roots and not source_lemmas:
462            return []
463
464        root_placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(source_roots))
465        lemma_placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(source_lemmas))
466
467        query = f"""
468            SELECT
469                wt.surah_number,
470                wt.ayah_number,
471                COUNT(DISTINCT ta.root_id) as shared_roots,
472                COUNT(DISTINCT ta.lemma_id) as shared_lemmas,
473                GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ta.root_id) as roots_list,
474                GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ta.lemma_id) as lemmas_list
475            FROM word_token wt
476            JOIN token_analysis ta ON ta.token_id = wt.token_id
477            WHERE wt.edition_id = ?
478              AND ta.dataset_id = 'qac-morphology'
479              AND (ta.root_id IN ({root_placeholders}) OR ta.lemma_id IN ({lemma_placeholders}))
480              AND NOT (wt.surah_number = ? AND wt.ayah_number = ?)
481            GROUP BY wt.surah_number, wt.ayah_number
482            HAVING shared_roots >= ? OR shared_lemmas >= ?
483            ORDER BY shared_roots DESC, shared_lemmas DESC
484            LIMIT ?
485        """
486
487        params = (
488            [self.edition_id]
489            + list(source_roots)
490            + list(source_lemmas)
491            + [surah_num, ayah_num, min_shared_roots, min_shared_lemmas, limit]
492        )
493
494        rows = self.data_access.db.fetchall(query, params)
495
496        results = []
497        for row in rows:
498            roots_list = row["roots_list"].split(",") if row["roots_list"] else []
499            lemmas_list = row["lemmas_list"].split(",") if row["lemmas_list"] else []
500
501            root_forms = [r.replace("qac-root:", "").replace("_", " ") for r in roots_list]
502            lemma_forms = [lm.replace("qac-lemma:", "") for lm in lemmas_list]
503
504            results.append(CrossReference(
505                source_reference=reference,
506                target_reference=f"{row['surah_number']}:{row['ayah_number']}",
507                relation_type="lexical_overlap",
508                evidence=f"Shared roots: {', '.join(root_forms)}; Shared lemmas: {', '.join(lemma_forms)}",
509                source_dataset="computed",
510                confidence=min(1.0, (row["shared_roots"] + row["shared_lemmas"]) / 10.0),
511                claim_category=ClaimCategory.COMPUTATIONAL_SUGGESTION,
512            ))
513
514        return results

517class WujuhWaNazairAnalyzer:
518    """Detects wujuh wa nazair pairs."""
519
520    def __init__(self, data_access: DataAccess | None = None, edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1"):
521        self.data_access = data_access or DataAccess()
522        self.edition_id = edition_id
523
524    def find_candidates(
525        self,
526        min_shared_words: int = 3,
527        max_candidates: int = 100,
528        similarity_threshold: float = 0.4,
529    ) -> list[WujuhWaNazairPair]:
530        """Find candidate wujuh wa nazair pairs."""
531        ayahs = self.data_access.db.fetchall(
532            """
533            SELECT surah_number, ayah_number, text_original
534            FROM ayah_text
535            WHERE edition_id = ?
536            ORDER BY surah_number, ayah_number
537            """,
538            (self.edition_id,),
539        )
540
541        if not ayahs:
542            return []
543
544        normalized_texts = {}
545        token_sets = {}
546
547        for row in ayahs:
548            ref = f"{row['surah_number']}:{row['ayah_number']}"
549            norm = normalize(row["text_original"], "diacritics-insensitive-v1")
550            normalized_texts[ref] = norm.normalized
551            token_sets[ref] = set(norm.normalized.split())
552
553        candidates = []
554        refs = list(normalized_texts.keys())
555
556        for i in range(len(refs)):
557            for j in range(i + 1, len(refs)):
558                ref1, ref2 = refs[i], refs[j]
559
560                tokens1 = token_sets[ref1]
561                tokens2 = token_sets[ref2]
562
563                shared = tokens1 & tokens2
564                if len(shared) < min_shared_words:
565                    continue
566
567                union = tokens1 | tokens2
568                jaccard = len(shared) / len(union) if union else 0.0
569
570                if jaccard < similarity_threshold:
571                    continue
572
573                text1 = next(r["text_original"] for r in ayahs if f"{r['surah_number']}:{r['ayah_number']}" == ref1)
574                text2 = next(r["text_original"] for r in ayahs if f"{r['surah_number']}:{r['ayah_number']}" == ref2)
575
576                candidates.append(WujuhWaNazairPair(
577                    ayah1_reference=ref1,
578                    ayah1_text=text1,
579                    ayah2_reference=ref2,
580                    ayah2_text=text2,
581                    similarity_score=jaccard,
582                    shared_words=list(shared),
583                    difference_notes=f"Jaccard similarity: {jaccard:.3f}; {len(shared)} shared words",
584                    claim_category=ClaimCategory.RESEARCH_HYPOTHESIS,
585                ))
586
587        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x.similarity_score, reverse=True)
588        return candidates[:max_candidates]

def create_research_tools( data_access: qurankit.storage.access.DataAccess | None = None, edition_id: str = 'tanzil-uthmani-v1') -> dict[str, typing.Any]: 
653def create_research_tools(
654    data_access: DataAccess | None = None,
655    edition_id: str = "tanzil-uthmani-v1",
656) -> dict[str, Any]:
657    """Factory to create all research analysis tools."""
658    vocab = QuranicVocabulary(data_access=data_access, edition_id=edition_id)
659    return {
660        "semantic_relations": SemanticRelationExtractor(),
661        "collocations": CollocationAnalyzer(vocabulary=vocab, data_access=data_access, edition_id=edition_id),
662        "cross_references": CrossReferenceAnalyzer(data_access=data_access, edition_id=edition_id),
663        "wujuh_wa_nazair": WujuhWaNazairAnalyzer(data_access=data_access, edition_id=edition_id),
664    }
